words.en: Obey instructions without delay.

words.ex: He uses spreadsheets to track his expenses.
words.ex_cn: 他使用电子表格来记录开销。
words.en: A spreadsheet is a computer program that is used for displaying and dealing with numbers. It shows them in rows and columns, and can be used to do calculations.

words.ex: The teacher showed us slides about the solar system.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们展示了关于太阳系的幻灯片。
words.en: Slides can refer to a series of images projected onto a screen or a surface, typically used in presentations, or to a smooth, inclined surface for children to play on by sliding down. As a verb, it means to move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it.

words.tr: phrase. 检查份量；核对食物或其他物品的分配数量
words.ex: She checks portions before serving the meal.
words.ex_cn: 她在上菜前检查份量。
words.en: To examine or inspect the size, quantity, or allocation of food servings or portions.

words.tr: phrase. 支持资深主厨们；协助高级厨师
words.ex: He helps to support senior chefs in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他帮助支持厨房里的资深厨师。
words.en: Assist or work under the direction of senior chefs.

words.tr: phrase. 预约；安排会面；约定时间
words.ex: He makes appointments with his doctor every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月都预约看医生。
words.en: To arrange a time to meet someone or do something, especially with a professional or official.

words.tr: phrase. 维护数据库；保持数据库的正常运行与更新
words.ex: He maintains the database every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天维护数据库。
words.en: To keep a database up to date and functioning correctly.

words.tr: 短语动词. 处理询问；应对咨询
words.ex: He deals with inquiries from customers every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天处理顾客的询问。
words.en: To handle or manage questions or requests for information.

words.tr: phrase. 重新安排预约；改期约会
words.ex: He will reschedule appointments for next week.
words.ex_cn: 他将把预约改到下周。
words.en: To change the scheduled time of meetings or appointments.

words.tr: phrase. 取下戒指和手镯；摘掉戒指与手链
words.ex: Please remove rings and bracelets before the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 实验前请取下戒指和手链。
words.en: To take off jewelry worn on the fingers or wrists.

words.tr:
v. 适合；相配；
n. 套装；西装；诉讼；
words.ex: This color suits her well.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色很适合她。
words.en: A suit is a set of clothes made from the same fabric, usually consisting of a jacket and trousers or a skirt. As a verb, to suit means to be appropriate or acceptable for someone or something.

words.ex: The store sells all kinds of footwear.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种鞋类。
words.en: Footwear refers to garments worn on the feet, which typically serve the purpose of protection against adversities of the environment such as ground textures and temperature.

words.ex: He wore a white waistcoat with his suit.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件白色背心搭配西装。
words.en: A waistcoat is a sleeveless garment that buttons down the front, typically worn over a shirt and under a jacket as part of a man's formal or business attire.

words.ex: He put on his jacket before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了夹克。
words.en: A jacket is a short coat with long sleeves.

words.ex: He wears a plain shirt to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿一件素色衬衫去上班。
words.en: A simple, unadorned shirt without patterns or decorations.

words.tr:
adj. 一致的；统一的；
n. 制服；
words.ex: The students wear a uniform shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿一致的衬衫去学校。
words.en: A uniform is a special set of clothes which some people, for example soldiers or the police, wear to work in and which some children wear at school. It is also used to describe something that is the same in all parts and does not vary.

words.tr: phrase. 休假；休息时间；请假
words.ex: He asked for time off to visit his family.
words.ex_cn: 他请假去探望家人。
words.en: Time off refers to a period of time that someone is allowed to be away from their work or duties, often for rest or vacation.

words.tr: adj. 有组织的； v. 组织；“organize”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She is an organized student who keeps her books in order.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有条理的学生，把书整理得井井有条。
words.en: If something is organized, it is arranged in an orderly, efficient way.

words.ex: He got his driving license last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾照。
words.en: A driving license is an official document which shows that you have passed the necessary tests and are allowed to drive a vehicle.

words.tr: 短语. 查验犯罪记录；审查某人是否有犯罪历史
words.ex: The employer will check criminal background before hiring.
words.ex_cn: 雇主在雇佣前会核查犯罪记录。
words.en: To investigate a person's past for any criminal records.

words.tr: phrase. 发送一篇评论；提交一份评价
words.ex: He will send a review after using the product.
words.ex_cn: 他使用完产品后会发送一份评价。
words.en: To submit or publish an evaluation or opinion about something.

words.tr: phrase. 进行一次测试；给予一次考试
words.ex: He gave a test on algebra last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周给了一个关于代数的测验。
words.en: To administer an examination or assessment.

words.tr: abbr. 简历；履历；“curriculum vitae”的缩写
words.ex: He sent his cv to the company.
words.ex_cn: 他把简历发给了公司。
words.en: A document that summarizes a person's education, work experience, and other qualifications for a job.

words.ex: He got a work permit to work in Canada.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了在加拿大工作的许可证。
words.en: A work permit is an official document giving someone the right to work in a particular country or area.

words.ex: He got his driving certificates last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了他的驾驶执照。
words.en: A certificate is an official document that gives details to show that something is true or has been done, or that shows someone has passed an examination or achieved a qualification.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.tr: phrase. （由裁判/推荐人）作证，担保；指由第三方（如裁判或推荐人）提供证明或保证某事的真实性或某人的可靠性
words.ex: The coach will vouch from referee that the player followed the rules.
words.ex_cn: 教练将由裁判作证，证明这名球员遵守了规则。
words.en: To provide a formal recommendation or guarantee from a reference.

words.tr: phrase. 雇佣中介；职业介绍所
words.ex: He found a job through an employment agency.
words.ex_cn: 他通过一家职业介绍所找到了工作。
words.en: An employment agency is a business that helps people to find jobs and employers to find suitable workers.

words.tr: n. 全体人员；人事部；职员；
words.ex: The company hired new personnel last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月雇佣了新员工。
words.en: The people who are employed in a company or organization.

words.ex: He found a job through the labor exchange.
words.ex_cn: 他通过劳动力交易所找到了工作。
words.en: A labor exchange is an organization that helps people find jobs and employers find workers.

words.ex: He went to the employment exchange to find a job.
words.ex_cn: 他去就业服务中心找工作。
words.en: An employment exchange is a government office where people who are looking for jobs can go to get help in finding work.

words.ex: We watched a play at the theatre last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在剧场看了一场戏。
words.en: A theatre is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.tr: phrase. 历史兴趣；历史价值
words.ex: The old house has historical interest because it was built in 1800.
words.ex_cn: 这座老房子具有历史价值，因为它建于1800年。
words.en: Historical interest refers to the curiosity or concern about the past, including events, people, and cultures.

words.tr: phrase. 西班牙音乐；源自西班牙或具有西班牙风格的音乐
words.ex: He listens to spanish music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听西班牙音乐。
words.en: Music originating from Spain, characterized by its diverse styles and influences, including flamenco, classical, and pop.

words.tr: phrase. 希腊绘画；指古希腊或现代希腊的艺术绘画作品
words.ex: The museum displays ancient greece paintings.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了古希腊绘画。
words.en: Paintings originating from Greece, often reflecting the artistic styles and cultural themes of ancient Greek civilization.

words.ex: We visited a museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个博物馆。
words.en: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

words.ex: The cathedral has tall towers and stained glass windows.
words.ex_cn: 这座大教堂有高高的塔楼和彩绘玻璃窗。
words.en: A cathedral is a very large and important church which has a bishop in charge of it.

words.ex: We walked on the beach at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 我们在日落时漫步在海滩上。
words.en: A beach is a landform along the coast of an ocean, sea, lake, or river. It usually consists of loose particles, which are often composed of rock, such as sand, gravel, shingle, pebbles, or cobblestones.

words.ex: Forests are home to many animals.
words.ex_cn: 森林是许多动物的家园。
words.en: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.

words.ex: They swim in the swimming pool every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天早上在游泳池里游泳。
words.en: A swimming pool is a large container filled with water, designed for people to swim in.

words.ex: The children play near the fountain in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园的喷泉附近玩耍。
words.en: A fountain is a structure that squirts water into the air to create a visual or auditory effect, or a natural source of water.

words.ex: They bathe in a hot spring every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天早上在温泉里洗澡。
words.en: A hot spring is a natural spring of water whose temperature is higher than that of the surrounding area, often heated by geothermal activity.

words.ex: The ancient temple stands on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的庙宇矗立在山上。
words.en: A temple is a building used for the worship of a god or gods in some religions.

words.ex: He was born in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: A village is a small group of houses in the country, smaller than a town.

words.tr: n. 雕刻（术）；雕塑品；雕刻品；
words.ex: He made a beautiful sculpture from clay.
words.ex_cn: 他用黏土做了一件精美的雕刻。
words.en: Sculpture is the art of making two- or three-dimensional representative or abstract forms, especially by carving stone or wood or by casting metal or plaster.

words.tr:
n. 塔；塔楼；
v. 高耸；
words.ex: The tower stands tall in the center of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这座塔矗立在城市中心。
words.en: A tower is a tall, narrow building, either part of a larger building such as a church or castle, or standing alone.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A castle is a large building or group of buildings fortified against attack with thick walls, battlements, towers, and in many cases a moat.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日参观了一个美术馆。
words.en: A place where works of art are displayed for public viewing.

words.ex: She plants flowers in her garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里种花。
words.en: A garden is a piece of land next to a house, with flowers, vegetables, other plants, and often grass.

words.ex: There are 745 markets in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市有745个市场。
words.en: Places or systems where goods and services are bought and sold.

words.tr: phrase. 天然湿地；自然形成的沼泽或湿地生态系统
words.ex: The natural wetland is home to many birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片天然湿地是许多鸟类的家园。
words.en: A natural wetland is an area of land whose soil is saturated with moisture, such as a marsh, swamp, or bog, and is characterized by the presence of water-loving plants and wildlife.

words.ex: He reads the book every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上读这本书。
words.en: To read the contents of a book from beginning to end.

words.ex: He reads the newspaper every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读报纸。
words.en: A newspaper is a publication consisting of a number of large sheets of folded paper, on which news, advertisements, and other information is printed.

words.ex: He read the booklet about the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 他读了那本关于新规则的小册子。
words.en: A booklet is a small, thin book that has a paper cover and that gives you information about something.

words.ex: He handed out a leaflet about the event.
words.ex_cn: 他分发了一份关于该活动的传单。
words.en: A leaflet is a small sheet of printed paper that gives you information or advertises something.

words.ex: He put up a poster on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张海报贴在墙上。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.ex: He booked his flight through a travel agency.
words.ex_cn: 他通过一家旅行社预订了航班。
words.en: A travel agency is a business that helps people plan and book trips and vacations.

words.ex: The tour guide showed us the old castle.
words.ex_cn: 导游带我们参观了这座古老的城堡。
words.en: A tour guide is a person who leads groups of people around a town, museum, or other tourist attraction, providing information about the place.

words.tr: phrase. 有导游的观光旅游
words.ex: We took a guided tour of the museum.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了博物馆的导览。
words.en: A guided tour is a tour of a place that is led by a guide who provides information about the place.

words.tr: phrase. 接待区；接待楼；学校或机构中专门用于接待的建筑物
words.ex: The guests waited in the reception block.
words.ex_cn: 客人们在接待区等候。
words.en: A reception block is a designated area within a building or complex where visitors are received and attended to, often serving as the first point of contact for guests or clients.

words.ex: The bus is crowded during peak time.
words.ex_cn: 在高峰期，公交车很拥挤。
words.en: The period during which the highest levels of activity or demand occur.

words.tr: phrase. 非高峰时间；低谷时段
words.ex: The train is less crowded during off-peak time.
words.ex_cn: 在非高峰时段，火车人少一些。
words.en: A period when demand for something is lower than at other times, often resulting in lower prices.

words.tr: phrase. 夏季假期：英国和爱尔兰学年之间的夏季学校假期，以及学校学年中的休息时间。
words.ex: We went to the beach during summer holiday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在暑假去了海滩。
words.en: A summer holiday is a long break from school or work that occurs during the summer months.

words.ex: We arrived at the airport early.
words.ex_cn: 我们早早到达了机场。
words.en: An airport is a place where aircraft regularly take off and land, with buildings for passengers to wait in.

words.ex: He walks to the city center every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行去市中心。
words.en: The central part of a city, where most of the commercial and cultural activities take place.

words.ex: We stayed at a small hotel near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在海边一家小旅馆里。
words.en: A hotel is a building where people stay, for example on holiday, paying for their rooms and meals.

words.tr:
n. 平方；广场；正方形；四方形；
adj. 正方形的；四方形的；平方的；成直角的；
v. 与...一致；
adv. 成直角地；
words.ex: The area of the room is 16 square.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的面积是16平方米。
words.en: A square is a shape with four sides of equal length and four angles of 90 degrees. It can also refer to an open area in a town, often used for public events, or to the result of multiplying a number by itself.

words.ex: I wait for the bus at station 15.
words.ex_cn: 我在15号车站等公交车。
words.en: A station is a place where trains, buses, or other vehicles regularly stop so that people can get on or off, or where a particular activity or service is based.

words.ex: They go to the shopping center on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们周末去购物中心。
words.en: A shopping center is a group of shops and other commercial establishments built together on one site.

words.ex: I took a taxi to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 我打了一辆出租车去机场。
words.en: A taxi is a car driven by someone whose job is to take people where they want to go in return for money.

words.ex: I took a cab to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 我打了一辆出租车去机场。
words.en: A cab is a taxi, a vehicle that carries passengers for a fare, usually calculated by a meter.

words.tr: n. 往返移动之物；航天飞机；
words.ex: The bus is a shuttle between the hotel and the airport.
words.ex_cn: 这辆巴士是酒店和机场之间的往返交通工具。
words.en: A shuttle is a vehicle that travels frequently between two places. In weaving, a shuttle is a device used to carry the weft thread back and forth across the loom.

words.ex: The plane landed safely at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在机场安全着陆。
words.en: A plane is a vehicle designed for air travel that has wings and one or more engines.

words.ex: The departure of the train was at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 火车的出发时间是晚上8点。
words.en: The act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a journey.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.tr: n. 小巴；小型公共汽车；
words.ex: The children took the minibus to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐小巴去学校。
words.en: A minibus is a small bus, usually one that carries fewer than twenty passengers.

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.ex: I take the subway to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天坐地铁去上班。
words.en: An underground railway system in a city, usually operated by electricity, which provides a rapid means of transportation.

words.ex: He takes the metro to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘地铁去上班。
words.en: A metro is an underground railway system in a city.

words.ex: He bought a single ticket to the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张音乐会的单程票。
words.en: A ticket for a journey to a place but not back again.

words.ex: He bought a one-way ticket to New York.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张去纽约的单程票。
words.en: A ticket for travel from one place to another but not back again.

words.ex: He bought a return ticket to London.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张去伦敦的往返票。
words.en: A return ticket is a ticket for a journey to a place and back again.

words.ex: I will book a seat on the train tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要预订火车座位。
words.en: To reserve a place or position, typically for travel or an event.

words.tr: phrase. 预订座位；预留座位
words.ex: I will reserve a seat for you.
words.ex_cn: 我会为你预留一个座位。
words.en: To book or hold a seat in advance for a particular event or journey.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.ex: He made a provisional booking for the hotel.
words.ex_cn: 他为酒店做了一个临时预订。
words.en: To arrange a booking that is not yet confirmed and may be changed or cancelled.

words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.tr: phrase. 钓鱼之旅；钓鱼远足
words.ex: We went on a fishing trip last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上个周末去钓鱼了。
words.en: A fishing trip refers to an excursion or journey taken with the purpose of catching fish, often for sport or recreation.

words.ex: I went shopping for groceries yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天去购物买杂货了。
words.en: The activity of buying things from shops.

words.tr: phrase. 有导游带领的丛林徒步
words.ex: We went on a guided bushwalk in the national park.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一次有向导的丛林徒步。
words.en: A guided bushwalk is a walk through the bush or forest, led by a guide who provides information about the natural environment.

words.tr: phrase. 爬行动物公园；爬虫园
words.ex: We visited a reptile park to see snakes and lizards.
words.ex_cn: 我们参观了一个爬行动物公园，去看蛇和蜥蜴。
words.en: A reptile park is a facility where reptiles are kept in enclosures and displayed to the public, often for educational purposes.

words.ex: He plays table tennis every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午打乒乓球。
words.en: Table tennis, also known as ping-pong, is a sport in which two or four players hit a lightweight ball back and forth across a table using small rackets.

words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打网球。
words.en: Tennis is a game played by two or four players on a rectangular court, in which a ball is hit back and forth over a net using rackets.

words.tr: phrase. 骑骆驼；骑在骆驼上
words.ex: They ride on a camel in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 他们在沙漠里骑骆驼。
words.en: To sit on and control the movement of a camel, typically for travel or as a recreational activity.

words.ex: The boy rides a horse every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩每天早上骑马。
words.en: A horse is a large animal which people can ride. Some horses are used for pulling ploughs and carts.

words.ex: The donkey carries water on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这头驴在山上驮水。
words.en: A donkey is a four-legged animal related to the horse, but smaller and with longer ears. Donkeys are often used for carrying or pulling things, especially in parts of the world where there are no cars or trucks.

words.tr: 短语动词. 喂羊；给羊喂食
words.ex: He goes to the farm to feed sheep every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都去农场喂羊。
words.en: To provide food to sheep, typically as part of farm care or animal husbandry.

words.tr: v. 日光浴( sunbathe的现在分词 )
words.ex: He is sunbathing on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他正在海滩上晒太阳。
words.en: The activity of sitting or lying in the sun, especially to tan the skin.

words.tr: n. 游泳；游泳运动； v. “swim”的现在分词；
words.ex: Swimming is good for your health.
words.ex_cn: 游泳对健康有益。
words.en: the sport or activity of moving through water by moving your arms and legs

words.ex: He takes photos of the sunset every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拍夕阳的照片。
words.en: To capture images using a camera.

words.tr:
n. 乘船游览；航游；
v. 乘船游览；航游；
words.ex: We went on a cruise around the Mediterranean Sea.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘船游览了地中海。
words.en: To sail about in an area without a precise destination, especially for pleasure.

words.ex: The steamship crossed the ocean in five days.
words.ex_cn: 这艘轮船在五天内横渡了海洋。
words.en: A steamship is a ship that is powered by steam engines, especially one that carries passengers and cargo across the sea.

words.ex: We watched three plays last week.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周看了三部戏剧。
words.en: To engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose.

words.ex: The band is playing music.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队在演奏音乐。
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for binding or decoration, or a range of frequencies or wavelengths in a spectrum.

words.tr: n. 冲浪运动； v. 冲浪；“surf”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves surfing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末冲浪。
words.en: Surfing is the sport of riding on the top of a wave while standing or lying on a special board.

words.ex: We had a barbecue in the park last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们在公园举行了户外烧烤。
words.en: A barbecue is a meal or gathering at which meat, fish, or other food is cooked out of doors on a rack over an open fire or on a special appliance.

words.tr: phrase. 观鲸体验；观赏鲸鱼的活动经历
words.ex: We had a whale watch experience near the coast.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海岸附近有一次观鲸体验。
words.en: An activity or tour where people observe whales in their natural habitat, often from a boat.

words.tr: phrase. 赛艇比赛；划船比赛
words.ex: They watch the boat race every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年夏天都观看划船比赛。
words.en: A boat race is a competition in which boats or crews of boats race against each other.

words.ex: The birds live in a nature reserve.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟生活在自然保护区。
words.en: A nature reserve is a protected area of importance for wildlife, flora, fauna or features of geological or other special interest, which is reserved and managed for conservation and to provide special opportunities for study or research.

words.ex: The company offers door-to-door service for all packages.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司提供上门取送所有包裹的服务。
words.en: A service that involves going directly to a customer's home or business to deliver or collect something.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.tr: n. 航班；飞行；（阶梯的）一段；
words.ex: The flight to Beijing leaves at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 飞往北京的航班早上8点起飞。
words.en: A flight is a journey made by flying, usually in an aircraft.

words.ex: We had a quick meal at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃了一顿简单的饭。
words.en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

words.ex: We have dinner at 7 p.m. every day.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天晚上7点吃晚餐。
words.en: The main meal of the day, eaten in the evening or at midday.

words.ex: We served refreshments after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议后我们提供了茶点。
words.en: Light snacks and drinks served to guests or participants at an event.

words.ex: He drinks tea every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝茶。
words.en: Tea is a drink made by pouring boiling water onto the dried leaves of the tea bush. It is popular in many countries and is often served hot with milk and sugar.

words.ex: He drinks coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝咖啡。
words.en: Coffee is a hot drink made from the roasted and ground seeds of a tropical shrub.

words.ex: He drinks orange juice every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝橙汁。
words.en: The liquid obtained from or present in fruit or vegetables.

words.ex: He drinks mineral water every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝矿泉水。
words.en: Water that contains dissolved mineral salts, especially carbonates, sulfates, and phosphates of calcium, magnesium, sodium, and iron, and is often effervescent.

words.tr:
n. 折扣；
v. 不全信；不重视；
words.ex: The store gave a 20% discount on all shoes.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有鞋子提供了20%的折扣。
words.en: A reduction in the usual price of something, or the act of reducing the price.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.ex: He drives a red car to work.
words.ex_cn: 他开车去上班。
words.en: A car is a motor vehicle with four wheels, usually propelled by an internal combustion engine.

words.tr: phrase. 美景；好风景；漂亮的景色
words.ex: The hotel has a nice view of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有很好的海景。
words.en: A nice view refers to a pleasing or attractive sight, often of a landscape or scenery.

words.tr: n. 音乐会；演奏会；一致；和谐；
words.ex: We went to a concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.ex: He plays the guitar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天弹吉他。
words.en: A guitar is a musical instrument with six strings that you play by plucking or strumming the strings.

words.ex: He plays the piano every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上弹钢琴。
words.en: A piano is a large musical instrument with a keyboard. When you press the keys, small hammers hit strings inside the piano, which produce musical notes.

words.ex: He plays the violin every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉小提琴。
words.en: A violin is a musical instrument with four strings, played with a bow.

words.ex: He plays the flute every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上吹长笛。
words.en: A flute is a musical instrument of the woodwind family. You play it by blowing over a hole at one end while holding it sideways.

words.ex: He plays the drum in a band.
words.ex_cn: 他在乐队里打鼓。
words.en: A drum is a musical instrument consisting of a skin stretched tightly over a round frame. You play it by hitting it with sticks or with your hands.

words.ex: He plays the cello every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉大提琴。
words.en: A cello is a large stringed instrument of the violin family, tuned an octave below the viola.

words.ex: He plays jazz on the piano every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上用钢琴演奏爵士乐。
words.en: Jazz is a type of music of black American origin characterized by improvisation, syncopation, and usually a regular or forceful rhythm, emerging at the beginning of the 20th century.

words.ex: He listens to pop music every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天听流行音乐。
words.en: Pop music is a genre of popular music that originated in its modern form during the mid-1950s in the United States and the United Kingdom.

words.tr: phrase. 传统舞蹈；指代具有民族文化或历史传承的舞蹈形式
words.ex: They perform traditional dance at the festival.
words.ex_cn: 他们在节日上表演传统舞蹈。
words.en: A dance form that has been passed down through generations within a culture or community.

words.tr: phrase. 现代舞；20世纪初兴起的、突破古典芭蕾程式、强调个性与创新的舞蹈形式
words.ex: He loves to practice modern dance after school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢放学后练习现代舞。
words.en: A style of theatrical dancing that is not as restricted as classical ballet; movements are expressive of feelings.

words.tr: phrase. 西班牙舞蹈（指具有西班牙民族风格的舞蹈，如弗拉门戈等）
words.ex: They perform spanish dance at the festival.
words.ex_cn: 他们在音乐节上表演西班牙舞蹈。
words.en: A traditional or cultural dance originating from Spain, such as flamenco or salsa.

words.tr:
n. 摇摆；
v. 摇摆；
words.ex: The child enjoyed the swing at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子喜欢在公园里荡秋千。
words.en: If something swings or if you swing it, it moves repeatedly backwards and forwards or from side to side from a fixed point. If you swing somewhere, you move there by holding onto something and moving your body through the air.

words.ex: He plays the oboe in the school band.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校乐队里吹双簧管。
words.en: A woodwind instrument with a double-reed mouthpiece, a slender tubular body, and holes stopped by keys.

words.ex: We went to a theme park last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末去了一家主题公园。
words.en: A theme park is a type of amusement park that bases its structures and attractions around a central theme, often featuring multiple areas with different themes.

words.ex: We visited a national park last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个国家公园。
words.en: A national park is an area of land that is protected by the government because of its natural beauty, plants, or animals, and is open to the public for enjoyment and education.

words.tr: phrase. 植物园；专门用于种植和展示各种植物的公园
words.ex: We walked in the botanical park and saw many flowers.
words.ex_cn: 我们在植物园里散步，看到了许多花。
words.en: A botanical park is a place where a wide variety of plants are grown for scientific study, conservation, and display to the public.

words.ex: The cat sat on the ledge of the window.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在窗户的架状突出物上。
words.en: A ledge is a narrow horizontal surface projecting from a wall, cliff, or other surface.

words.ex: The sailors slept in the cabin during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 水手们在风暴期间睡在船舱里。
words.en: A cabin is a small room or compartment, especially one on a ship or an aircraft.

words.ex: They slept in a tent during the camping trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在露营时睡在帐篷里。
words.en: A tent is a portable shelter made of fabric or other material stretched over a supporting framework of poles and usually stabilized or secured to the ground with cords and stakes.

words.ex: They live in a small cottage near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一座小村舍里。
words.en: A cottage is a small house, usually in the countryside.

words.ex: We set up our tent at the campsite near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 我们在湖边的野营地搭了帐篷。
words.en: A campsite is a place where people who are camping can stay, often with facilities such as toilets and showers.

words.tr: n. 取消；撤销；作废；中止；
words.ex: The flight cancellation made us wait for a new ticket.
words.ex_cn: 航班取消让我们不得不等待新的机票。
words.en: The act of cancelling something; a situation in which something that has been arranged is stopped from happening.

words.tr: phrase. 错过出发（指旅客未能在规定时间搭乘已预订的航班、火车或其他交通工具）
words.ex: He missed departure because he arrived at the airport too late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为到机场太晚而错过了出发。
words.en: A missed departure refers to the situation where someone fails to leave at the scheduled time, often resulting in the need to make alternative arrangements.

words.tr: phrase. 个人财物；私人物品；随身物品
words.ex: He packed his personal belongings before leaving the hotel.
words.ex_cn: 他离开酒店前收拾了自己的个人物品。
words.en: Personal belongings refer to items that are owned by a particular person and are typically carried with them or kept in their personal space.

words.ex: He wants to make a claim about his lost bag.
words.ex_cn: 他想对他丢失的包提出索赔。
words.en: To make a claim means to formally request something, especially money, because you think it is owed to you, or to state that something is true, even though it has not been proved.

words.ex: The currency in Japan is the yen.
words.ex_cn: 日本的货币是日元。
words.en: The system of money in general use in a particular country.

words.ex: He needs a visa to travel to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一张签证去日本旅行。
words.en: A visa is an official document, or a stamp put in your passport, which allows you to enter or leave a particular country.

words.ex: He paid with Mastercard at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店用万事达卡付款。
words.en: A brand of credit card.

words.ex: He pays with American Express.
words.ex_cn: 他用美国运通卡付款。
words.en: American Express is an international financial services corporation best known for its credit card, charge card, and traveler's cheque businesses.

words.ex: I will make a reservation for two people.
words.ex_cn: 我将为两个人预订。
words.en: To book or arrange for something in advance, such as a table at a restaurant.

words.ex: I call the restaurant to confirm a reservation.
words.ex_cn: 我给餐厅打电话确认预订。
words.en: To confirm a reservation means to verify or establish the certainty of a booking arrangement.

words.ex: He cancel his reservation at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 他取消了在餐厅的预订。
words.en: To cancel one's reservation means to decide not to keep a booking or appointment that one has made, often by informing the place where the booking was made.

words.tr: phrase. 先到先得的（通常指服务或分配按到达顺序进行）
words.ex: The tickets are first come first serve, so arrive early.
words.ex_cn: 票是先到先得的，所以早点来。
words.en: A principle that the first people to arrive will be attended to or served before others.

words.tr: phrase. 完全订满的；全部预约完毕的
words.ex: The hotel is fully booked for the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店周末已经订满了。
words.en: Completely occupied or reserved, with no available spaces or slots left.

words.ex: The teacher changed the seat arrangement for the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师为了考试改变了座位安排。
words.en: The organization or placement of seats in a particular order or pattern for an event or gathering.

words.ex: The camel walks across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼穿越沙漠。
words.en: A desert is a large area of land that has very little water and very few plants growing on it. Many deserts are covered by sand. If you desert someone or something, you leave them and no longer help or support them.

words.ex: The farmers live in hilly areas.
words.ex_cn: 这些农民住在多山的地区。
words.en: Regions or landscapes characterized by many hills, often uneven and rolling terrain.

words.tr: n. 水族馆；水族箱；养鱼缸；
words.ex: We visited the aquarium to see the fish.
words.ex_cn: 我们去水族馆看鱼。
words.en: A tank or building in which fish and other water creatures and plants are kept.

words.ex: The children loved the circus with clowns and elephants.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢有小丑和大象的马戏团。
words.en: A circus is a group of performers that include clowns, acrobats, and trained animals, who travel to different places to entertain people.

words.ex: He works in a vineyard near the hills.
words.ex_cn: 他在山边的一个葡萄园工作。
words.en: A vineyard is a plantation of grape-bearing vines, grown mainly for winemaking, but also raisins, table grapes and non-alcoholic grape juice.

words.ex: The kangaroos live in the bushland near the city.
words.ex_cn: 袋鼠生活在城市附近的未开垦森林地带。
words.en: Land covered with bushes.

words.ex: Monkeys live in the tropical rain forest.
words.ex_cn: 猴子生活在热带雨林中。
words.en: A tropical rain forest is a dense, warm, wet forest found in regions near the equator, characterized by high biodiversity and a significant amount of rainfall.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.ex: The Great Wall is a famous tourist attraction.
words.ex_cn: 长城是一个著名的游览胜地。
words.en: A place of interest where tourists visit, typically for its inherent or exhibited natural or cultural value, historical significance, natural or built beauty, offering leisure, adventure, and amusement.

words.ex: The fishers live in coastal areas.
words.ex_cn: 渔民住在沿海地区。
words.en: Coastal areas are the regions where the land meets the sea or ocean. These areas are often characterized by their unique ecosystems, economies, and communities that are influenced by their proximity to the water.

words.tr:
adj. 公平的；相当大的；合理的；
n. 集市；
words.ex: The teacher gave a fair grade to every student.
words.ex_cn: 老师给每个学生都给了一个公平的分数。
words.en: Fair means treating people equally without favouritism or discrimination.

words.ex: They went on a spotlight tour of the city last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末他们进行了城市观光游。
words.en: A spotlight tour refers to a tour or visit that focuses on highlighting specific aspects or features, often used in the context of music tours or guided visits to places of interest.

words.ex: The backpacker walked through the mountains with a big bag.
words.ex_cn: 那个背包客背着一个大包穿越了山脉。
words.en: A backpacker is someone who travels or hikes carrying their belongings in a backpack.

words.ex: The waterfall makes a loud sound.
words.ex_cn: 瀑布发出很大的声音。
words.en: A waterfall is a place where water flows over the edge of a steep, high cliff in hills or mountains, and falls into a pool below.

words.ex: He drives a car with four-wheel drive.
words.ex_cn: 他开一辆四轮驱动的车。
words.en: A four-wheel drive is a vehicle that is capable of transmitting power to all four wheels simultaneously, providing better traction especially on slippery or uneven surfaces.

words.ex: We took the ferry to cross the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘渡船过河。
words.en: A ferry is a boat that transports passengers and sometimes also vehicles, usually across rivers or short stretches of sea.

words.ex: They parked the caravan by the lake for the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们把旅行拖车停在湖边过周末。
words.en: A caravan is a group of people, especially traders or pilgrims, traveling together across a desert in Asia or North Africa.

words.tr: phrase. 太阳能汽车；依靠太阳能驱动的车辆
words.ex: He built a solar car for the science fair.
words.ex_cn: 他为科学展造了一辆太阳能汽车。
words.en: A solar car is an electric vehicle powered completely or significantly by direct solar energy. Usually, photovoltaic (PV) cells contained in solar panels convert the sun's energy directly into electric energy.

words.ex: He takes the tram to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上乘电车上班。
words.en: A tram is a vehicle that is used for public transportation in cities and towns, running on tracks laid in the streets.

words.ex: The city built a new light rail to help people travel faster.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市新建了一条轻轨，以帮助人们更快出行。
words.en: A light rail is a form of urban rail public transportation that generally has a lower capacity and lower speed than heavy rail and metro systems, but higher capacity and higher speed than traditional street-running tram systems.

words.tr: n. 远足；徒步旅行； v. 增加；“hike”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves hiking in the mountains on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末去山里远足。
words.en: Hiking is the activity of going for long walks in the countryside for pleasure.

words.tr: v. 搭便车旅游；沿途搭乘别人车旅行
words.ex: He wants to hitchhike across the country.
words.ex_cn: 他想搭便车横跨全国。
words.en: To travel by getting free rides from passing vehicles.

words.ex: He drives a red van to work.
words.ex_cn: 他开一辆红色的货车去上班。
words.en: A van is a road vehicle used for transporting goods or people, usually larger than a car but smaller than a truck.

words.ex: He took an airport limousine to the hotel.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐机场豪华轿车去酒店。
words.en: A limousine service provided for transportation to and from an airport, offering a luxurious and comfortable ride for passengers.

words.tr:
n. 泊位；（船上的）卧铺
v. 停泊；占铺位
words.ex: The ship found a berth at the dock.
words.ex_cn: 船在码头找到了停泊位。
words.en: A berth is a bed on a boat, train, or other vehicle, or a place where a boat or ship can be tied up in a harbor.

words.ex: The teacher stood on the platform to speak.
words.ex_cn: 老师站在平台上讲话。
words.en: A platform is a flat, raised structure, usually made of wood, which people stand on when they make speeches or give performances.

words.ex: He loves scuba diving in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在海洋里潜水。
words.en: Scuba diving is an underwater swimming activity where divers use a self-contained underwater breathing apparatus (scuba) to breathe underwater.

words.tr: n. 滑雪（运动）； v. “ski”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves skiing in the mountains during winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天去山上滑雪。
words.en: The activity or sport of moving over snow on skis.

words.tr: phrase. 水上滑板；水上滑雪
words.ex: He loves water skiing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末玩水上滑板。
words.en: Water skiing is a surface water sport in which an individual is pulled behind a boat or a cable ski installation over a body of water, skimming the surface on two skis or one ski.

words.ex: He loves hang gliding over the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在山上空滑翔。
words.en: Hang gliding is a sport in which a person flies by hanging from a large glider that is not powered.

words.ex: He plays water polo every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六打水球。
words.en: Water polo is a team water sport, which can be played in a swimming pool or in the sea. The game consists of four quarters in which the two teams attempt to score goals by throwing the ball into the opposing team's goal.

words.ex: I bought a souvenir from the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我从海边买了一个纪念品。
words.en: A souvenir is something which you buy or keep to remind you of a holiday, place, or event.

words.ex: He dried himself with a beach towel after swimming.
words.ex_cn: 他游泳后用沙滩毛巾擦干身体。
words.en: A beach towel is a large towel used for drying off after swimming or lying on at the beach.

words.ex: He looks at the stars through a telescope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过望远镜看星星。
words.en: A telescope is an optical instrument designed to make distant objects appear nearer, containing an arrangement of lenses, or of curved mirrors and lenses, by which rays of light are collected and focused and the resulting image magnified.

words.ex: He bought new walking boots for the hike.
words.ex_cn: 他为远足买了新的1058型徒步靴。
words.en: Walking boots are sturdy footwear designed for walking long distances, typically used for hiking or trekking.

words.ex: He puts on sunscreen before going to the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他去海滩前涂防晒霜。
words.en: A sunscreen is a cream that you put on your skin to protect it from the sun's rays.

words.ex: He bought a saver ticket for the train.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张优惠火车票。
words.en: A saver ticket is a type of ticket that is offered at a reduced price, often with certain restrictions such as being valid only during off-peak times.

words.ex: He bought an open ticket to visit his family whenever he can.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张不定期机票，以便随时去看望家人。
words.en: An issue or matter that has not been resolved or closed.

words.ex: He bought a round trip ticket to New York.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张去纽约的往返票。
words.en: A round trip is a journey to a place and back again.

words.tr: phrase. 一流的；头等舱；第一类邮件；第一堂课
words.ex: He got a first class result in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中取得了一流的成绩。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as first class, you mean that they are extremely good and of the highest quality.

words.ex: He flew in business class to save time.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐商务舱飞行以节省时间。
words.en: Business class refers to a high-quality travel class available on some airlines and rail lines, offering more comfortable seating, better food, and more amenities than economy class.

words.ex: He booked an economy class ticket for the flight.
words.ex_cn: 他为航班预订了经济舱机票。
words.en: Economy class is the cheapest type of seats in a plane or train.

words.tr: n. 临时滞留；中途停留；短暂停留
words.ex: We had a short layover in Dubai.
words.ex_cn: 我们在迪拜有一个短暂的中转。
words.en: A layover is a short stay in a place in between parts of a journey, especially a wait between airplane flights.

words.ex: We had a stopover in Dubai on our way to Sydney.
words.ex_cn: 我们在飞往悉尼的途中在迪拜中途停留。
words.en: A stopover is a short stay in a place in between parts of a journey, especially a long journey.

words.ex: He took a non-stop flight to New York.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐了一趟直达纽约的航班。
words.en: A non-stop flight is a flight that travels directly from one place to another without any stops.

words.tr: phrase. 转接班机；中转飞行
words.ex: I have a connecting flight in Dubai.
words.ex_cn: 我在迪拜有转机航班。
words.en: A connecting flight is a flight that requires passengers to change planes at an intermediate stop before reaching their final destination.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.tr:
n. 土地；陆地；
v. 降落；着陆；
words.ex: The farmer owns a large piece of land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有一大片土地。
words.en: Land is an area of ground, especially one that is used for a particular purpose such as farming or building.

words.ex: Please complete the check-in at the front desk.
words.ex_cn: 请在前台完成签到。
words.en: The act of reporting one's presence, especially at a hotel or an airport, or the place where this happens.

words.ex: He paid the airport tax before boarding.
words.ex_cn: 他在登机前支付了机场税。
words.en: A fee charged to passengers by the airport authority, which is used to fund the maintenance and development of airport facilities.

words.ex: He bought chocolate in a duty-free shop at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场的免税店买了巧克力。
words.en: A duty-free shop is a retail outlet whose goods are exempt from the payment of certain local or national taxes and duties, provided the goods are sold to travelers who will take them out of the country.

words.tr: phrase. 超重行李费；超出免费托运限额的行李收费
words.ex: He paid the excess baggage charge at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场支付了超重行李费。
words.en: An excess baggage charge is a fee that airlines charge to passengers who have luggage that exceeds the allowed weight or size limits.

words.ex: There is a vacant seat next to me.
words.ex_cn: 我旁边有一个空座位。
words.en: A vacant seat is a seat that is not occupied.

words.ex: The train's destination is Beijing.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车的目的地是北京。
words.en: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.tr:
n. 额外费用；附加费
v. 额外索价；附加罚款
words.ex: He paid a surcharge for extra baggage.
words.ex_cn: 他为额外行李支付了附加费。
words.en: An additional charge or payment.

words.ex: The estimated time of arrival is 5 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 预计到达时间是下午五点。
words.en: The expected time when someone or something will arrive.

words.ex: The estimated time of departure is 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 预计出发时间是下午三点。
words.en: The estimated time when a vehicle, especially an aircraft, is expected to depart.

words.tr: n. 损失；伤亡人数；通行费；
words.ex: The war caused a heavy toll on innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 战争给平民带来了巨大的损失。
words.en: A toll is a small sum of money that you have to pay in order to use a particular bridge or road. / A toll is the total number of deaths, accidents, or disasters that occur in a particular period of time. / When a bell tolls, it rings slowly and repeatedly, often as a sign that someone has died.

words.ex: He drives on the expressway every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走高速公路。
words.en: An expressway is a wide road that allows traffic to move quickly from one place to another, especially between cities.

words.ex: He paid the parking meter with coins.
words.ex_cn: 他用硬币支付了停车计时器。
words.en: A parking meter is a device used to collect money in exchange for the right to park a vehicle in a particular place for a limited amount of time.

words.ex: He needs a parking permit to park near the office.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一张停车许可证才能在办公室附近停车。
words.en: A parking permit is an official document that allows you to park your vehicle in a particular place.

words.tr:
n. 粘附物；胶粘物；不干胶标签；贴纸；不屈不挠的人
v. 给…贴上标签价
words.ex: He put a sticker on his notebook.
words.ex_cn: 他在笔记本上贴了一个粘附物。
words.en: A sticker is a small piece of paper or plastic with a picture or writing on one side and glue on the other side, which you can stick onto a surface.

words.ex: He paid a fine for parking illegally.
words.ex_cn: 他因非法停车支付了罚款。
words.en: To pay a fine means to give money as a penalty for breaking a law or rule.

words.ex: The car was towed away because it was parked illegally.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车被拖走了，因为它停在了不允许停车的地方。
words.en: To remove a vehicle by towing it, especially because it is illegally parked or causing an obstruction.

words.ex: The mechanic clamped the wheel to prevent the car from moving.
words.ex_cn: 修理工锁住了轮胎，以防止汽车移动。
words.en: To secure or fasten a wheel, often using a tool like a clamp, to prevent it from moving.

words.tr: phrase. 自动变速器；自动换挡装置
words.ex: The car has automatic gears.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有自动挡。
words.en: Automatic gears refer to a transmission system in vehicles that changes gears automatically without the need for manual intervention.

words.tr: phrase. 手动齿轮；手动变速装置
words.ex: He drives a car with manual gears.
words.ex_cn: 他开一辆有手动挡的车。
words.en: Manual gears refer to a type of transmission in vehicles that requires the driver to manually change gears.

words.tr: phrase. 淡蓝色的；浅蓝色的
words.ex: The sky is light blue today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是浅蓝色的。
words.en: A light blue color is a pale shade of blue.

words.tr: phrase. 鲜亮的蓝色；明亮的蓝色
words.ex: The sky is bright blue today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是明亮的蓝色。
words.en: A bright blue color is very vivid and noticeable, often associated with the color of the sky on a clear day.

words.ex: He wears a navy blue shirt to work.
words.ex_cn: 他上班时穿一件藏蓝色的衬衫。
words.en: A very dark blue color.

words.tr: phrase. 品蓝；宝蓝；皇家蓝（一种鲜艳而深的蓝色）
words.ex: He wore a royal blue shirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件皇家蓝的衬衫去参加派对。
words.en: Royal blue is a deep and vivid shade of blue. It is said to have been created by clothiers in Rode, Somerset, a consortium of whom won a competition to make a dress for Queen Charlotte, consort of King George III.

words.tr: phrase. 天蓝色的；蔚蓝色的
words.ex: The sky is sky blue today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是天蓝色的。
words.en: A light, bright blue color resembling the sky on a clear day.

words.ex: The car is painted metallic grey.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车涂成了金属灰色。
words.en: A color that resembles the reflective and shiny qualities of metal, typically a shade of grey.

words.ex: He used his old car in a part exchange for a new one.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的旧车以旧换新换了一辆新车。
words.en: A transaction in which a used item is given as partial payment for a new one.

words.ex: The lion roars loudly in the wild.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在野外大声吼叫。
words.en: A lion is a large wild animal of the cat family, which is found in Africa. Lions have yellowish fur, and male lions have a mane.

words.ex: The fox ran quickly through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 狐狸快速地跑过森林。
words.en: A fox is a wild animal which looks like a dog and has reddish-brown fur, a pointed face and ears, and a thick tail. Foxes are often described as cunning and sly.

words.ex: The leopard runs fast in the wild.
words.ex_cn: 豹在野外跑得很快。
words.en: A large wild cat that has a yellowish-brown or brown coat with black spots, found in Africa and southern Asia.

words.ex: The tiger walks quietly in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 老虎在森林里静静地行走。
words.en: A tiger is a large wild animal that has a yellow and black striped coat and is a member of the cat family.

words.ex: The car has high mileage.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车行驶的英里数很高。
words.en: Mileage refers to the distance traveled, measured in miles, or the benefits or advantages gained from a particular situation or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 合理的条件；适当的状态；可接受的情况
words.ex: The employer offered a reasonable condition for the job.
words.ex_cn: 雇主提供了这份工作的合理条件。
words.en: In a fair, moderate, or acceptable state or situation.

words.tr: n. 羽毛球运动；羽毛球；
words.ex: He plays badminton every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打羽毛球。
words.en: A game played with rackets and a shuttlecock, which is hit back and forth across a high net.

words.tr: n. 慢跑； v. “jog”的现在分词；
words.ex: He goes jogging every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去慢跑。
words.en: Jogging is the activity of running at a slow, regular speed, especially as a form of exercise.

words.ex: He practices judo every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午练习柔道。
words.en: A sport of unarmed combat derived from jujitsu and intended to train the body and mind. It involves using holds and leverage to unbalance the opponent.

words.ex: He does weightlifting every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上举重。
words.en: Weightlifting is a sport in which competitors lift heavy weights, either as a single lift or as a combination of lifts, in order to demonstrate their strength.

words.tr:
v. 伸展；延伸；持续；
n. 一段；伸展；
words.ex: He stretches his arms every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上伸展手臂。
words.en: To stretch is to extend your body or a part of your body to its full length, or to extend something else to its full length or beyond its normal limits.

words.tr: n. 游泳；游泳运动； v. “swim”的现在分词；
words.ex: Swimming is good for your health.
words.ex_cn: 游泳对健康有益。
words.en: the sport or activity of moving through water by moving your arms and legs

words.ex: He does yoga every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做瑜伽。
words.en: Yoga is a Hindu spiritual and ascetic discipline, a part of which, including breath control, simple meditation, and the adoption of specific bodily postures, is widely practiced for health and relaxation.

words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打网球。
words.en: Tennis is a game played by two or four players on a rectangular court, in which a ball is hit back and forth over a net using rackets.

words.ex: He plays golf every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都打高尔夫。
words.en: Golf is a game in which you use long sticks called clubs to hit a small hard ball into holes that are spread out over a large area of grassy land.

words.ex: He plays football with his friends every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末和朋友踢足球。
words.en: A game played by two teams of eleven players with a round ball that may not be touched with the hands or arms during play except by the goalkeepers. The object of the game is to score goals by kicking or heading the ball into the opponents' goal.

words.ex: He practices kickboxing every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上练习跆拳道。
words.en: Kickboxing is a form of martial arts that combines elements of boxing with kicking techniques.

words.ex: We ate dinner at a small restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在一家小餐厅吃了晚饭。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.ex: He drinks coffee at a small cafe.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小咖啡馆喝咖啡。
words.en: A cafe is a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold.

words.ex: He picked his dinner from the salad bar.
words.ex_cn: 他从沙拉吧挑选了他的晚餐。
words.en: A salad bar is a buffet-style table or counter at a restaurant or food service facility where customers can assemble their own salad plates from a variety of ingredients.

words.tr: phrase. 果汁吧；鲜榨果汁店
words.ex: He buys a smoothie at the juice bar.
words.ex_cn: 他在果汁吧买了一杯奶昔。
words.en: A juice bar is a place where you can buy fresh juice and sometimes smoothies, often made from fruits and vegetables.

words.tr: phrase. 会员计划；会员制度；会员方案
words.ex: He joined the membership scheme to get discounts.
words.ex_cn: 他加入了会员计划以获得折扣。
words.en: A membership scheme is a plan or system that offers benefits to members, often in return for a fee.

words.ex: The teacher gave an assessment of the students' work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作品进行了评估。
words.en: An assessment is a judgment about something, especially about how good or bad it is, or an amount that is calculated for something, especially for tax purposes.

words.ex: He joined a trial session to test the new gym.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一次试用课程来体验新健身房。
words.en: A period of testing or evaluation to determine suitability or performance, especially in a professional or athletic context.

words.ex: He wears a helmet when he rides a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他骑自行车时戴头盔。
words.en: A helmet is a strong, hard hat which is worn to protect your head.

words.ex: He rides his bicycle to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天骑自行车去上学。
words.en: A bicycle is a vehicle with two wheels which you ride by sitting on it and pushing two pedals with your feet.

words.tr: phrase. 修理包；维修工具包；修补用具套装
words.ex: He bought a repair kit for his bicycle.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的自行车买了一个维修工具包。
words.en: A set of tools and materials used for repairing something, especially carried in a vehicle for use in emergencies.

words.tr: phrase. 冲浪旅行；冲浪之旅
words.ex: They went on surfing trips every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年夏天都去冲浪旅行。
words.en: A surfing trip is a journey or excursion undertaken with the primary purpose of surfing.

words.ex: He wears a wetsuit to swim in cold water.
words.ex_cn: 他穿潜水服在冷水中游泳。
words.en: A wetsuit is a close-fitting garment made of rubber or neoprene, worn by surfers, divers, and others who engage in water sports in cold water, to keep their bodies warm.

words.tr:
n. 冲浪板
v. 以冲浪板滑水
words.ex: He bought a new surfboard last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周买了一块新的冲浪板。
words.en: A surfboard is a long narrow board that is used for surfing.

words.ex: The boat is parked in the bay.
words.ex_cn: 船停在海湾里。
words.en: A bay is a body of water partially enclosed by land, typically smaller than a gulf. It can also refer to a compartment for a ship, the color of a horse, or the sound a dog makes.

words.ex: He wore heavy boots to walk in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了厚重的靴子在雪地里走路。
words.en: Boots are a type of footwear that covers the foot and extends up the leg, sometimes to the knee or even the hip. They are typically made of leather or rubber and are worn for protection against cold, wet, or rugged terrain.

words.tr: phrase. 船舶代理人；负责处理船舶在港口事务的代理人员或公司
words.ex: The ship agent helps the captain with customs papers.
words.ex_cn: 船务代理帮助船长处理海关文件。
words.en: A ship agent is a person or company that acts on behalf of the ship owner or charterer in arranging for the ship's entry and clearance at ports, and for the handling of cargo and passengers.

words.tr: phrase. 咨询号码；参考号码
words.ex: Please call the hotline and give your reference number.
words.ex_cn: 请拨打热线并提供你的咨询号码。
words.en: A reference number is a unique identifier assigned to a specific transaction or document, used for tracking and identification purposes.

words.tr: n. 一件物品或商品；项目；一则；
words.ex: This item is on sale for $5.
words.ex_cn: 这件商品正在促销，售价5美元。
words.en: An item is one of a collection or list of objects.

words.ex: He wants to make a claim about his lost bag.
words.ex_cn: 他想对他丢失的包提出索赔。
words.en: To make a claim means to formally request something, especially money, because you think it is owed to you, or to state that something is true, even though it has not been proved.

words.ex: He kept the dishes in the cabinet.
words.ex_cn: 他把盘子放在储藏柜里。
words.en: A cabinet is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves or drawers, used for storing or showing things. In politics, a cabinet is a group of people who are chosen by a head of state to give advice and to help set government policy.

words.tr: n. 均匀厚度的片状硬物体；盘子；碟子；“plate”的复数；
words.ex: The metal plates are used to build the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 这些金属片用于建造桥梁。
words.en: Plates are flat, usually round dishes that are used to hold food. They can also refer to thin, flat pieces of metal or other material.

words.ex: He went to the clinic for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去诊所做检查。
words.en: A clinic is a place where people receive medical treatment or advice, especially for a particular illness or condition.

words.tr: phrase. 擅长与婴儿相处的；对婴儿有耐心的；能很好照顾婴儿的
words.ex: She is good with babies.
words.ex_cn: 她很擅长照顾婴儿。
words.en: Having a natural ability or temperament to interact calmly and effectively with infants or young children.

words.tr: phrase. 提供晚间预约；安排晚上就诊/会面时间
words.ex: The clinic offers evening appointment for working people.
words.ex_cn: 这家诊所为上班族提供晚间预约。
words.en: To provide or schedule a consultation or service during the late afternoon or night hours.

words.tr: phrase. 小额费用；小额收费
words.ex: He pays small charges for parking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天支付小额停车费。
words.en: Small charges refer to minor fees or costs associated with a service or transaction.

words.tr: phrase. 以付费方式；按有偿原则；在需付费的基础上
words.ex: He works on a paying basis at the local gym.
words.ex_cn: 他在当地健身房以付费方式工作。
words.en: On a paying basis means that something is provided or done in exchange for payment.

words.tr: phrase. 付费使用服务；需付费才能使用的服务
words.ex: This app is a pay-to-use service.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用是一个付费使用的服务。
words.en: A service that requires payment for each use or access.

words.ex: He has heart disease and must eat healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 他患有心脏病，必须吃健康的食物。
words.en: A condition that affects the heart and blood vessels, often leading to serious health issues.

words.ex: He has lung problems from smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吸烟有肺部问题。
words.en: Issues or diseases affecting the lungs, which are essential for breathing.

words.tr: 适用于所有年龄段的 adj.
words.ex: This game is fun for all ages.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏适合所有年龄段的人。
words.en: Suitable for people of any age.

words.ex: He had many injuries from playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他踢足球时受了很多伤。
words.en: Injuries refer to physical harm or damage to someone's body caused by an accident or an attack.

words.ex: He fell and hurt his knee.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒了，伤了膝盖。
words.en: The knee is the joint between the thigh and the lower leg in humans.

words.ex: He rubbed his shoulder after lifting the box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬完箱子后揉了揉肩膀。
words.en: The part of the body at each side of the neck where the upper limb or forelimb is attached; to accept or take on (a responsibility or task).

words.ex: He twisted his ankle while running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步时扭伤了脚踝。
words.en: The joint between the foot and the leg, in which movement occurs in two planes.

words.ex: He hurt his neck while lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他在举重时伤了脖子。
words.en: The part of a person's or animal's body connecting the head to the rest of the body.

words.tr:
n. 手臂；
v. 武装；
words.ex: He raised his arm to wave hello.
words.ex_cn: 他举起手臂打招呼。
words.en: An arm is one of the two long parts of your body that are attached to your shoulders and that have your hands at the end.

words.ex: He rubbed his chest after the cough.
words.ex_cn: 他咳嗽后揉了揉胸部。
words.en: The front part of a person's body between the neck and the stomach, or a large strong box used for storing things.

words.tr:
n. 肘部
v. 用肘推挤
words.ex: He hurt his elbow while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打篮球时伤了肘部。
words.en: The joint between the forearm and the upper arm; to push someone with your elbow.

words.tr:
adv. 回原处；向后；
n. 后面；背部；
v. 支持；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: He put the book back on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放回了书架。
words.en: The back is the rear surface of the human body from the shoulders to the hips.

words.tr:
n. 脚趾
v. 用脚尖触
words.ex: He touched the ball with his toe.
words.ex_cn: 他用脚趾碰了球。
words.en: One of the five digits at the end of the foot, or the similar part of a shoe or sock.

words.ex: He hurt his foot while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了脚。
words.en: The lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks.

words.ex: He stepped on my heel by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心踩到了我的脚后跟。
words.en: The heel is the back part of the foot, below the ankle. It can also refer to the part of a shoe or boot that supports this part of the foot.

words.ex: He hurt his thigh while running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步时伤了大腿。
words.en: The part of the human leg between the hip and the knee.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: A leg is one of the limbs on which a person or animal walks and stands.

words.ex: He took painkillers for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了止痛药来缓解头痛。
words.en: Painkillers are drugs used to reduce or eliminate pain without causing loss of consciousness.

words.tr: phrase. 应用冰的；指将冰直接用于身体部位以减轻肿胀或疼痛的治疗方法
words.ex: The applied ice reduced the swelling quickly.
words.ex_cn: 使用的冰迅速减轻了肿胀。
words.en: To apply cold treatment (e.g., an ice pack) to an injury or area to reduce swelling or pain.

words.ex: He has allergies to pollen and dust.
words.ex_cn: 他对花粉和灰尘过敏。
words.en: Allergies are abnormal immune system reactions to things that are typically harmless to most people.

words.ex: Eating fruits gives you vitamin C.
words.ex_cn: 吃水果可以给你维生素C。
words.en: A vitamin is one of a group of organic substances which are essential in small quantities to the nutrition of most animals and some plants, and which are present in natural foodstuffs or sometimes produced within the body.

words.tr: phrase. 更好的照明；更佳的灯光效果
words.ex: The new room has better lighting.
words.ex_cn: 这个新房间有更好的照明。
words.en: Improved illumination, making an area brighter and easier to see.

words.tr: 短语. 拥有更多人行小径；增加步行道
words.ex: The town has more footpaths now.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇现在有更多的小径。
words.en: To have more pedestrian walkways or paths for walking.

words.tr: phrase. 公交线路；公共汽车行驶的路线
words.ex: The new bus routes help people get to work faster.
words.ex_cn: 新的公交路线帮助人们更快地到达工作地点。
words.en: The paths or lines that buses follow to travel from one place to another within a city or area.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet improves your safety.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔能提高你的安全。
words.en: Safety refers to the condition of being protected from or unlikely to cause danger, risk, or injury.

words.tr: phrase. 更频繁的列车；班次更多的火车
words.ex: The city will have more frequent trains next year.
words.ex_cn: 明年这个城市将会有更频繁的火车。
words.en: Trains that run more often than usual, aiming to provide better service and reduce waiting times for passengers.

words.tr: phrase. 自行车道；专供自行车行驶的车道
words.ex: The city built new cycle lanes for bikers.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市为骑自行车的人修建了新的自行车道。
words.en: Cycle lanes are parts of the road that are only for bicycles, marked by lines or a different colour to separate them from the rest of the traffic.

words.tr: phrase. 安全的停车地点；安全的泊车场所
words.ex: The hotel offers safe parking places for guests.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店为客人提供安全的停车场所。
words.en: Locations where vehicles can be parked with a low risk of theft or damage.

words.tr: phrase. 骑行训练；自行车锻炼
words.ex: He does cycling training every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上进行骑行训练。
words.en: Cycling training refers to the process of preparing and practicing for cycling races or events, focusing on improving endurance, speed, and technique.

words.ex: I wait for the bus at station 15.
words.ex_cn: 我在15号车站等公交车。
words.en: A station is a place where trains, buses, or other vehicles regularly stop so that people can get on or off, or where a particular activity or service is based.

words.ex: He bought a train ticket at the ticket office.
words.ex_cn: 他在售票处买了一张火车票。
words.en: A ticket office is a place where tickets are sold to the public for admission to a theater, for travel on public transportation, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 售票机；自动售票机
words.ex: He bought a ticket from the ticket machine.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动售票机买了一张票。
words.en: A ticket machine is a machine from which you can buy tickets, for example for travel on public transport or for entry to a cinema or theatre.

words.tr: phrase. 在线电子票；通过互联网购买或获取的电子机票或电子票据
words.ex: I bought an e-ticket online for my flight.
words.ex_cn: 我在线购买了航班的电子票。
words.en: A digital ticket for travel or events that is purchased and stored electronically.

words.ex: The box office closed at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 售票处在晚上8点关闭。
words.en: The box office refers to the office in a theatre, cinema, or concert hall where tickets are sold, or to the amount of money that a film, play, or actor has earned by selling tickets.

words.ex: He saw many shops with logo on the street.
words.ex_cn: 他在街上看到许多有标志的商店。
words.en: Retail stores that display or sell products featuring a specific brand's logo or emblem.

words.tr: phrase. 落后于计划；误点；拖延的
words.ex: The train is behind schedule.
words.ex_cn: 火车晚点了。
words.en: If someone or something is behind schedule, they are not progressing as quickly as planned or expected.

words.tr: phrase. 不可靠的；不可信赖的
words.ex: This clock is not reliable.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟不准。
words.en: Untrustworthy; not able to be depended on for accuracy or performance.

words.tr:
n. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；
v. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；
words.ex: The flight had a delay because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 由于风暴，航班推迟了。
words.en: If you delay doing something, you do not do it immediately or at the planned or expected time, but you leave it until later.

words.tr:
adj. 晚的；迟的；已故的；
adv. 晚；迟；
words.ex: The train is late.
words.ex_cn: 火车晚点了。
words.en: After the expected, usual, or proper time.

words.ex: The teacher stood on the platform to speak.
words.ex_cn: 老师站在平台上讲话。
words.en: A platform is a flat, raised structure, usually made of wood, which people stand on when they make speeches or give performances.

words.tr: phrase. 公交车的发车频率
words.ex: The frequency of buses is high during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段公交车的发车频率很高。
words.en: The number of times buses run on a particular route or service.

words.tr: phrase. 存储不足；缺乏存储空间
words.ex: He has a lack of storage for his clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他缺乏存放衣服的空间。
words.en: A situation where there is not enough space available for storing data or materials.

words.ex: The city has too much air pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市有太多的空气污染。
words.en: Air pollution refers to the presence of substances in the atmosphere that are harmful to the health of humans and other living beings, or cause damage to the climate or to materials.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.ex: He likes to read history books about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读关于古罗马的历史书籍。
words.en: History is the study of past events, particularly in human affairs.

words.ex: He reads magazines about sports every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读关于体育的杂志。
words.en: A magazine is a publication with a paper cover which is issued regularly, usually every week or every month, and which contains articles, stories, photographs, and advertisements.

words.tr: phrase. 旅行书籍；旅游指南或游记类图书
words.ex: He likes to read travel books about distant places.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读关于遥远地方的旅行书籍。
words.en: Books that provide information and guidance about destinations, itineraries, and travel experiences.

words.tr: n. （十三到十九岁的）青少年；“teenager”的复数；
words.ex: Teenagers often spend a lot of time on their phones.
words.ex_cn: 青少年经常花很多时间在手机上。
words.en: Teenagers are young people between the ages of 13 and 19.

words.tr: n. 小说( fiction的名词复数 ); 虚构的或想像出的事，并非完全真实的事
words.ex: He likes reading fictions before sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在睡觉前读小说。
words.en: Fictions are stories or narratives that are invented by the imagination, rather than being based strictly on history or fact.

words.tr:
n. （长篇）小说；
adj. 新颖的；新奇的；
words.ex: He wrote a novel about a brave girl.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一部关于一个勇敢女孩的小说。
words.en: A novel is a long written story about imaginary people and events.

words.tr: phrase. 参考书；工具书；参考资料书籍
words.ex: He uses reference books to find answers.
words.ex_cn: 他使用参考书来找答案。
words.en: Books intended to be consulted for authoritative information rather than read through.

words.ex: We have meetings every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周一都有会议。
words.en: A meeting is an event in which a group of people come together to discuss things or make decisions.

words.ex: He connects his phone to the wi-fi at home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家把手机连接到无线网络。
words.en: Wi-Fi is a system for connecting electronic equipment to the internet without using wires, by using radio signals.

words.tr: phrase. 图书馆商店；设在图书馆内的书店或纪念品商店
words.ex: The library shops are closed on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆的商店在周日关门。
words.en: A shop located within or associated with a library, selling books, stationery, and other related items.

words.ex: He is holding three cards in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他手里拿着三张牌。
words.en: Cards are pieces of stiff paper or thin cardboard, often with a picture on one side, which are used for playing games or for sending messages.

words.tr:
n. 粘附物；胶粘物；不干胶标签；贴纸；不屈不挠的人
v. 给…贴上标签价
words.ex: He put a sticker on his notebook.
words.ex_cn: 他在笔记本上贴了一个粘附物。
words.en: A sticker is a small piece of paper or plastic with a picture or writing on one side and glue on the other side, which you can stick onto a surface.

words.ex: He put a stamp on the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他在信封上贴了一张邮票。
words.en: A stamp is a small piece of paper which you stick on an envelope or package before you post it to pay for the cost of the postage. It can also mean to bring down your foot heavily on the ground or to impress a pattern or mark on a surface.

words.ex: I bought a souvenir from the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我从海边买了一个纪念品。
words.en: A souvenir is something which you buy or keep to remind you of a holiday, place, or event.

words.ex: The police caught the man for a serious crime.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了那个犯下严重罪行的人。
words.en: A crime is an illegal action or activity for which a person can be punished by law.

words.ex: The theft of the bike was reported to the police.
words.ex_cn: 这起自行车被盗事件已向警方报告。
words.en: Theft is the act of stealing.

words.ex: The robbery happened at the bank yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天银行发生了抢劫。
words.en: The crime of stealing from someone or somewhere, especially using violence or threats.

words.ex: He lost his wallet on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交车上丢了钱包。
words.en: A wallet is a small flat folding case made of leather or plastic, in which you can keep banknotes, credit cards, and other small flat objects.

words.tr: n. 女用小包；钱包；资金；
words.ex: She put her keys in her purse.
words.ex_cn: 她把钥匙放进她的女用小包里。
words.en: A purse is a small bag used especially by women to carry everyday personal items.

words.tr:
n. 电话；
v. 打电话；
words.ex: I lost my phone yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天丢了电话。
words.en: A phone is a piece of equipment that you use to talk to someone who is in another place.

words.ex: He paid with cash for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金买了面包。
words.en: Money in the form of coins or banknotes, especially that which is immediately available.

words.ex: He uses a credit card to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 他用信用卡买食物。
words.en: A credit card is a small plastic card that you use to buy things on credit or to borrow money.

words.ex: He lost his keys and can't get into the house.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了钥匙，进不了家门。
words.en: Keys are small pieces of shaped metal which you insert into a lock and turn in order to lock or unlock something such as a door or a drawer. They can also refer to the buttons on a computer keyboard or the answers to a test or puzzle.

words.ex: She has curly hair.
words.ex_cn: 她有卷发。
words.en: Hair that forms curls or ringlets.

words.ex: She has dark hair.
words.ex_cn: 她有黑发。
words.en: Hair that is naturally black or very dark brown in colour.

words.tr: phrase. 金发；浅黄色的头发
words.ex: She has blonde hair and blue eyes.
words.ex_cn: 她有金色的头发和蓝色的眼睛。
words.en: Hair that is yellow or pale gold in color.

words.ex: She has straight hair.
words.ex_cn: 她有直发。
words.en: Hair that does not curl or wave.

words.tr: n. 数字；数字( digit的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He wrote his phone number with digits.
words.ex_cn: 他用数字写下了他的电话号码。
words.en: Digits are the numbers from 0 to 9, or the fingers or toes on a person's hand or foot.

words.ex: He saved the file on a disk.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件保存在磁盘上。
words.en: A disk is a flat, circular object or a device used for storing digital information.

words.ex: The size of the box is too big for the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的大小对架子来说太大了。
words.en: The physical dimensions, proportions, magnitude, or extent of an object.

words.tr: phrase. 数字格式；以数字形式存储的数据格式
words.ex: The book is available in digital format.
words.ex_cn: 这本书以数字格式提供。
words.en: A version of a document, image, or data stored in a form that can be processed by a computer.

words.tr:
n. 框架；结构；骨架；模式；
v. 表达；陷害；
words.ex: The picture is in a wooden frame.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在一个木制框架里。
words.en: A frame is a structure that forms a border or support for something, such as a picture or a window. It can also refer to the process of making or constructing something, or the act of falsely incriminating someone.

words.ex: He flipped through the album with old photos.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看着装满旧照片的相册。
words.en: An album is a collection of several pieces of music, songs, or photographs that are intended to form a single item.

words.ex: He put the papers in a red folder.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件放进了一个红色的活页夹。
words.en: A folder is a thin piece of cardboard or plastic in which you can keep loose papers.

words.tr: adj. 脆弱的；易碎的；不牢固的；
words.ex: The glass is fragile and might break easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃很脆弱，容易碎。
words.en: If something is fragile, it is easily broken or damaged.

words.tr: phrase. 基本服务；基础服务
words.ex: The hotel offers basic service to all guests.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为所有客人提供基础服务。
words.en: A basic service is a fundamental service that is considered essential for the well-being of the population, such as water, electricity, and healthcare.

words.tr: phrase. 扫描照片（将纸质照片通过扫描仪转换为数字图像）
words.ex: He scans photos to save them on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他扫描照片以便保存到电脑上。
words.en: To examine or convert physical photographs into digital images using a scanner.

words.ex: He picked up the parcel from the post office.
words.ex_cn: 他从邮局取了包裹。
words.en: A parcel is something wrapped in paper, usually so that it can be sent to someone by post.

words.tr: phrase. 纸板箱；由硬纸板制成的用于包装或储存物品的箱子
words.ex: He put the toys in a cardboard box.
words.ex_cn: 他把玩具放进了一个纸板箱里。
words.en: A cardboard box is a container made from stiff paper material.

words.ex: He put the toys in a plastic box.
words.ex_cn: 他把玩具放进了一个塑料盒里。
words.en: A container made of plastic, used for storing or transporting items.

words.ex: He made the payment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在线支付了。
words.en: A payment is an amount of money that is paid to someone, or the act of paying this money.

words.tr: phrase. 进行改进；做出改善；加以改良
words.ex: He makes improvements to his bike every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都改进他的自行车。
words.en: To make changes or enhancements to something to make it better or more effective.

words.tr: phrase. 修饰颜色；润色颜色
words.ex: She will touch up color on her hair tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 她明天会补一下头发的颜色。
words.en: To improve or enhance the color of something by making small adjustments or additions.

words.ex: He will alter the background of the photo.
words.ex_cn: 他将更改照片的背景。
words.en: To change the area behind the main subject in a photograph or image.

words.tr: phrase. 移除一个物体；删除一个对象
words.ex: He will remove an object from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他将把桌上的一个物体拿走。
words.en: To delete or take away a specific item from a picture or scene.

words.tr: phrase. 提高对比度；增强反差
words.ex: She uses dark paint to improve the contrast.
words.ex_cn: 她用深色颜料来增强对比度。
words.en: To increase the difference between the light and dark areas in a photograph for better clarity.

words.tr: phrase. 清晰的；焦点对准的；处于关注中心的
words.ex: The cat is in focus in the photo.
words.ex_cn: 照片中的猫是清晰的。
words.en: If something is in focus, it is clearly defined and easy to see or understand.

words.tr: n. 构成；作曲；（学生）作文；创作技巧；
words.ex: The composition of the rock includes sand and clay.
words.ex_cn: 这种岩石的构成包括沙子和黏土。
words.en: The way in which something is composed or arranged; the act of creating something, especially a piece of writing or music.

words.tr: n. 时间的安排；时间的选择； v. “time”的现在分词；
words.ex: The timing of the meeting was perfect.
words.ex_cn: 会议的时间安排恰到好处。
words.en: Timing is the skill or action of judging the right moment in a situation or activity at which to do something.

words.tr: adj. 明亮的；鲜艳的；聪明的；
words.ex: The room is bright because of the big window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间因为大窗户而很明亮。
words.en: Emitting or reflecting much light; shining.

words.tr:
adj. 黑暗的；暗色的；深色的；
n. 黑暗；夜；暗色；
words.ex: The room was dark after the power went out.
words.ex_cn: 停电后，房间变得黑暗。
words.en: The absence of light in a place is referred to as dark. It can also describe something that is not light in color, or something that is mysterious or difficult to understand.

words.ex: The physician checked the patient's temperature.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的体温。
words.en: A physician is a medical doctor who is trained in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries.

words.ex: He visited an eye doctor for a checkup.
words.ex_cn: 他去看眼科医生做检查。
words.en: A medical professional specializing in the diagnosis and treatment of eye disorders and diseases.

words.ex: The surgeon fixed the broken bone.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生修复了断裂的骨头。
words.en: A surgeon is a medical doctor who performs operations.

words.tr:
n. 兽医；
v. 审查；
