words.ex: The vet checked the dog's health.
words.ex_cn: 兽医检查了狗的健康状况。
words.en: A vet is a person who is qualified to treat sick or injured animals. As a verb, to vet means to examine something or someone carefully to make sure they are suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: When the child got sick, they sent for a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子生病时，他们请了医生来。
words.en: To ask someone to go and get a doctor to come to a place, especially in an emergency.

words.ex: I will make an appointment with the doctor tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要预约医生。
words.en: To arrange a meeting or consultation at a specific time.

words.ex: He has a high fever as a symptom of the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧是流感的症状。
words.en: A symptom is a physical or mental feature which is regarded as indicating a condition of disease, particularly such a feature that is apparent to the patient.

words.ex: He goes out without a coat and catches a cold.
words.ex_cn: 他出去时没穿外套，结果感冒了。
words.en: To become ill with a cold.

words.ex: I have a sore throat, so I cannot speak loudly.
words.ex_cn: 我喉咙痛，所以不能大声说话。
words.en: To experience pain or discomfort in the throat.

words.ex: He had a stomachache after eating too much ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了太多冰淇淋后胃痛。
words.en: A stomachache is a pain in your stomach.

words.ex: He has a high fever and stays in bed.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧了，躺在床上休息。
words.en: A fever is a condition in which the body's temperature is higher than usual, often as a response to infection.

words.tr:
n. 咳嗽；
v. 咳嗽；
words.ex: He had a bad cough last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚咳得很厉害。
words.en: A cough is a sudden, forceful expulsion of air from the lungs, often caused by irritation in the airway.

words.tr: n. 头痛；令人头痛的人（或事物）；
words.ex: He got a headache after working too long.
words.ex_cn: 他工作太长时间后得了头痛。
words.en: A headache is a pain in your head. If you say that something is a headache, you mean that it causes you difficulty or worry.

words.ex: He has a toothache and cannot eat.
words.ex_cn: 他牙疼，不能吃东西。
words.en: A toothache is a pain in or around a tooth.

words.ex: I have a runny nose because I caught a cold.
words.ex_cn: 我流鼻涕是因为感冒了。
words.en: To have a condition where liquid mucus flows from the nose, often due to a cold or allergy.

words.ex: He felt deep depression after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的抑郁。
words.en: A period during which business, employment, and stock-market values decline severely or remain at a very low level of activity.

words.tr:
v. 呕吐；吐出；喷涌出
n. 呕吐；呕吐物
words.ex: He felt sick and vomited on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他感到恶心，就在地上吐了。
words.en: To eject matter from the stomach through the mouth.

words.tr: phrase. 呕吐；恶心；匆匆建造；产生；放弃
words.ex: He eats too fast and sometimes throws up.
words.ex_cn: 他吃得很快，有时会呕吐。
words.en: To vomit; to eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth.

words.tr: adj. 头晕目眩的；头昏眼花的；
words.ex: He felt dizzy after spinning around quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速转圈后感到头晕目眩。
words.en: If you feel dizzy, you feel that you are losing your balance and are about to fall.

words.ex: She feels chilly in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 她早上觉得冷。
words.en: To experience a sensation of coldness.

words.ex: He has liver trouble from drinking too much.
words.ex_cn: 他因为喝酒太多而有肝脏问题。
words.en: Liver trouble refers to any disorder or disease affecting the liver, which can range from mild conditions like fatty liver to severe ones like cirrhosis.

words.ex: He stayed home because he had the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他因为得了流感待在家里。
words.en: The flu is an infectious disease characterized by fever, aches and pains, and respiratory symptoms.

words.tr: adj. 扭曲的； v. “twist”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The twisted wire was hard to fix.
words.ex_cn: 这根扭曲的电线很难修理。
words.en: If something is twisted, it has been bent or turned so that it no longer has its original shape.

words.ex: He has asthma and cannot run fast.
words.ex_cn: 他有哮喘，不能跑快。
words.en: A respiratory condition marked by spasms in the bronchi of the lungs, causing difficulty in breathing. It usually results from an allergic reaction or other forms of hypersensitivity.

words.tr: adj. 糖尿病的；适合糖尿病患者的
words.ex: He is a diabetic and eats healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名糖尿病患者，吃健康的食物。
words.en: A diabetic is a person who has diabetes.

words.tr:
n. 抽筋；痉挛；夹钳
v. 束缚；使痉挛；用夹钳夹紧
words.ex: He got a cramp in his leg while running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步时腿抽筋了。
words.en: A cramp is a sudden, involuntary muscle contraction or over-shortening; while generally temporary and non-damaging, they can cause mild-to-severe pain, and a paralysis-like immobility of the affected muscle.

words.ex: I have a stuffed nose because of the cold.
words.ex_cn: 我因为感冒鼻子堵住了。
words.en: To experience nasal congestion, making it difficult to breathe through the nose.

words.ex: He has a stiff neck from sleeping wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他因为睡姿不对导致脖子僵硬。
words.en: A condition where the neck muscles are tight and painful, making it difficult to move the head.

words.ex: He got yellow fever while traveling in Africa.
words.ex_cn: 他在非洲旅行时感染了黄热病。
words.en: Yellow fever is a serious viral disease that is transmitted by mosquitoes, primarily in tropical regions of Africa and South America. It is characterized by fever, chills, severe headache, back pain, general body aches, nausea, and vomiting. In severe cases, it can cause liver damage leading to jaundice (which gives the disease its name), bleeding, and even death.

words.ex: He has hay fever in spring.
words.ex_cn: 他在春天患花粉热。
words.en: A common allergic condition affecting the mucous membranes of the nose, eyes, and air passages, typically caused by an allergy to pollen or dust.

words.ex: He took a pill for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一粒药丸来缓解头痛。
words.en: A pill is a small solid mass of medicine that you swallow whole.

words.tr: n. 平板电脑；（刻有文字的）匾；
words.ex: He uses a tablet to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他用平板电脑读书。
words.en: A tablet is a small, flat computer that is controlled by touching the screen. It can also refer to a small, solid piece of medicine that you swallow.

words.ex: He took a capsule for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一粒胶囊来缓解头痛。
words.en: A capsule is a small container or case, especially one that is sealed and contains a dose of medicine, or a spacecraft's compartment for astronauts.

words.ex: The recipe calls for a mixture of flour and water.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和水的混合物。
words.en: A mixture is a substance made by combining other substances together.

words.ex: He uses eyedrop when his eyes feel dry.
words.ex_cn: 当他的眼睛感到干涩时，他会使用眼药水。
words.en: A liquid medicine that is put into the eyes to treat eye conditions or relieve discomfort.

words.ex: He poured syrup on his pancakes.
words.ex_cn: 他把糖浆倒在煎饼上。
words.en: A thick, sweet liquid made by dissolving sugar in boiling water, often used as a topping for desserts or as a sweetener in drinks.

words.tr:
n. 垫；爪垫；便笺簿
v. 放轻脚步走
words.ex: She put a pad on the chair for comfort.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个垫子以增加舒适感。
words.en: A pad is a flat piece of material that is used to protect something, to make something more comfortable, or to absorb liquid.

words.ex: The doctor gave him penicillin for his infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他开了青霉素治疗感染。
words.en: An antibiotic drug obtained from molds or produced synthetically, used to treat infections caused by bacteria.

words.ex: The doctor gave me an antibiotic for my infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了抗菌素治疗感染。
words.en: A substance that can kill or inhibit the growth of bacteria and other microorganisms.

words.ex: He put ointment on his cut.
words.ex_cn: 他把药膏涂在伤口上。
words.en: A smooth substance that is rubbed on the skin to heal wounds or soothe pain.

words.tr: n. 药物；药物治疗；药物处理；
words.ex: He took his medication every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃药。
words.en: Medication refers to a substance used for medical treatment, especially a medicine or drug.

words.tr: n. 阿司匹林（镇痛解热消炎药）
words.ex: He took aspirin for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了阿司匹林来缓解头痛。
words.en: Aspirin is a common drug that is used to reduce pain and inflammation.

words.ex: He took a cold cure for his runny nose.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了感冒药来缓解流鼻涕。
words.en: A treatment or remedy for the common cold.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.tr:
n. 绷带
v. 用绷带包扎
words.ex: He put a bandage on his cut finger.
words.ex_cn: 他在他割伤的手指上贴了绷带。
words.en: A bandage is a piece of material used to cover a wound or to support an injured part of the body.

words.ex: The doctor uses a stethoscope to listen to his heart.
words.ex_cn: 医生用听诊器听他的心跳。
words.en: A stethoscope is an instrument that a doctor uses to listen to someone's heart and breathing. It consists of a small disc that is placed against the chest, and two tubes connected to earpieces.

words.ex: The doctor gave him an injection for the pain.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他打了一针来缓解疼痛。
words.en: An injection is the act of putting a liquid, especially a drug, into a person's body using a needle and a syringe.

words.tr: phrase. 预防性注射；预防针
words.ex: The doctor gave him a preventative injection before he traveled.
words.ex_cn: 医生在他旅行前给他打了一针预防性疫苗。
words.en: A preventative injection is a shot given to prevent diseases or conditions before they occur.

words.tr:
v. 提取；
n. 摘录；提取物；
words.ex: They extract oil from plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们从植物中提取油。
words.en: To remove or take out something, especially by effort or force.

words.ex: The nurse takes her temperature every morning.
words.ex_cn: 护士每天早上给她量体温。
words.en: To measure someone's body temperature, usually to check for fever.

words.ex: The doctor feels his patient's pulse every morning.
words.ex_cn: 医生每天早上都摸病人的脉搏。
words.en: To feel someone's pulse is to check their heart rate by pressing on their wrist, or to try to find out someone's opinions or feelings about something.

words.ex: The nurse checks one's blood pressure every morning.
words.ex_cn: 护士每天早上检查一个人的血压。
words.en: To measure the force of blood against the walls of the arteries as the heart pumps it around the body.

words.ex: The doctor gave a prescription for medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生开了药方。
words.en: To issue a written order for medication or treatment from a doctor.

words.ex: He will have an operation next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周要做手术。
words.en: Undergo a medical procedure performed by a surgeon.

words.ex: I withdrew cash from the atm near the bank.
words.ex_cn: 我在银行附近的自动取款机取了现金。
words.en: An ATM is a machine that allows people to take out money from their bank accounts by using a special card. ATM can also refer to Asynchronous Transfer Mode, a telecommunications concept defined by ANSI and ITU (formerly CCITT) standards for carriage of a complete range of user traffic, including voice, data, and video signals.

words.tr:
n. 出纳员，收银员
v. 革除（军职）
words.ex: The cashier counted the money at the end of the day.
words.ex_cn: 收银员在一天结束时清点了钱。
words.en: A cashier is a person whose job is to receive and pay out money in a shop, bank, or business.

words.ex: The bank gave a loan to the student.
words.ex_cn: 银行向学生提供了一笔贷款。
words.en: A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

words.ex: He withdraw money from the ATM every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五从自动取款机取钱。
words.en: To take cash from a bank account, typically using an ATM or over the counter.

words.ex: He forgot his password and could not log in.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记了密码，无法登录。
words.en: A password is a secret word or phrase that you must know in order to be allowed to enter a place or to use a computer system.

words.tr: n. 代码；编码；行为准则；密码；法典；
words.ex: He wrote a simple code to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段简单的代码来解决这个数学问题。
words.en: A code is a system of words, letters, figures, or other symbols substituted for other words, letters, etc., especially for the purposes of secrecy. As a verb, it means to convert (a message or other information) into a code.

words.tr: phrase. 活期存款帐户；活期存折；来往户头
words.ex: He checks his current account every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周检查他的活期账户。
words.en: A current account is a type of bank account that allows you to deposit and withdraw money frequently, and often comes with a cheque book and a debit card.

words.tr: phrase. 定期存款账户；储蓄存款账户
words.ex: He put his savings into a deposit account.
words.ex_cn: 他把积蓄存入了一个定期存款账户。
words.en: A deposit account is a bank account that earns interest and allows you to deposit and withdraw money, but typically does not come with a checkbook or debit card.

words.tr: phrase. 开立学生账户；为学生开设账户
words.ex: The bank will open a student's account for her.
words.ex_cn: 银行将为她开设一个学生账户。
words.en: To establish a bank or financial account for a student, typically with special terms or benefits.

words.ex: He checked his bank statement last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚查看了他的银行对账单。
words.en: A bank statement is a document that shows all the transactions that have occurred in a bank account over a specific period of time, usually a month.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a personal loan to buy a car.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请一笔个人贷款来买一辆车。
words.en: To request a loan for personal use, typically from a bank or financial institution.

words.tr: phrase. 把英镑兑换成美元
words.ex: He wants to change pounds into dollars.
words.ex_cn: 他想把英镑换成美元。
words.en: To exchange British currency for US currency.

words.ex: The current rate is $5 per hour.
words.ex_cn: 当前费率是每小时5美元。
words.en: The term 'the current rate' refers to the present level or amount at which something happens or is done, especially in financial contexts such as interest rates or exchange rates.

words.tr: phrase. 把钱换成五元面额
words.ex: He gave the money in fives to the cashier.
words.ex_cn: 他用五元钞票把钱给了收银员。
words.en: To provide cash in denominations of five units (e.g., five-dollar bills).

words.ex: He checks the balance on his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机查看余额。
words.en: To verify the amount of money available in a bank account or on a card.

words.ex: He signed his name with a clear signature.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的签名签了名字。
words.en: A signature is a person's name written in a distinctive way as a form of identification in authorizing a document or letter.

words.tr: phrase. 直接转移；直接转让；直通（尤指无需换乘的交通方式）
words.ex: He made a direct transfer from his bank to hers.
words.ex_cn: 他直接从自己的银行转账到她的账户。
words.en: A direct transfer refers to the immediate movement of funds from one account to another without the need for physical checks or cash.

words.tr: phrase. 最小总额；最低金额
words.ex: The minimum sum is five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 最低金额是五美元。
words.en: The smallest amount of money required, typically for a fee, payment, or investment.

words.tr: phrase. 卡片目录（用于图书馆中按卡片索引图书的系统）
words.ex: He found the book using the card catalogue.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卡片目录找到了这本书。
words.en: A card catalogue is a system for organizing information about the books and other materials in a library, consisting of cards with information on them that are arranged in a particular order.

words.ex: He showed his admission card to borrow a book.
words.ex_cn: 他出示了他的借书证来借书。
words.en: A ticket or pass that allows someone to enter a place or event.

words.tr: phrase. 期限；（图书馆）借书卡
words.ex: The date slip for the project is next Friday.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的期限是下周五。
words.en: A small piece of paper or a label that indicates a date, often used in libraries to show when a book is due back.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.tr: phrase. 终止日期；借书期限
words.ex: The date of expiry is tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 到期日期是明天。
words.en: The date on which something, especially a contract, agreement, or product, is no longer valid or usable.

words.tr: adj. 应给的；预期的；到期的；
words.ex: The payment is due tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 这笔款项明天应给。
words.en: If something is due at a particular time, it is expected to happen or be done at that time.

words.ex: The book is overdue, so I must pay a fine.
words.ex_cn: 这本书逾期了，所以我必须付罚款。
words.en: To be late in returning an item or making a payment, resulting in a financial penalty.

words.ex: He will renew his passport next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会更新他的护照。
words.en: To renew something means to begin it again or to make it new again.

words.ex: The book is out on loan to a student.
words.ex_cn: 这本书借给了一名学生。
words.en: If something is out on loan, it has been lent to someone and is not currently available.

words.ex: The book is closed reserved and cannot be borrowed.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是只读不借的。
words.en: A bank account that is no longer active and has been formally terminated.

words.tr: phrase. 在流通中；在从事社交活动中；在书库里
words.ex: The coins are in circulation now.
words.ex_cn: 这些硬币现在正在流通。
words.en: If something such as money is in circulation, it is being used by the public. If an idea or story is in circulation, it is being passed around among a group of people.

words.ex: This document is not for circulation.
words.ex_cn: 这份文件不得外传。
words.en: This term is used to denote items, especially currency or documents, that are not intended for general distribution or use among the public.

words.ex: The teacher gave a classification of animals into mammals and birds.
words.ex_cn: 老师将动物分为哺乳动物和鸟类。
words.en: The action or process of classifying something according to shared qualities or characteristics.

words.ex: This book belongs to the science category.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于科学类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: He added the bibliography at the end of his report.
words.ex_cn: 他在报告末尾添加了参考书目。
words.en: A bibliography is a list of the books and articles that have been used by someone when writing a particular book or article.

words.tr:
adj. 周期的；定期的
n. 期刊
words.ex: The plant has a periodical blooming cycle.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物有周期性的开花周期。
words.en: A periodical is a magazine, especially one that is published regularly, or something that happens at regular intervals.

words.ex: He reads science journals every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都读科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a magazine, especially one that deals with a specialized subject, or a daily record of events or business.

words.ex: Please return the book in time.
words.ex_cn: 请及时归还这本书。
words.en: To come or go back to a place or person at a suitable or expected time.

words.ex: The library has open shelves for easy access to books.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆设有开架书库，方便读者取阅书籍。
words.en: A system in a library where books are placed on open shelves, allowing readers to access them freely without the need for assistance.

words.ex: The books are on closed shelves.
words.ex_cn: 书在封闭的书架上。
words.en: Shelves that are enclosed with doors or panels to protect contents from dust.

words.tr: phrase. 复印设施；影印设备
words.ex: The library has photocopying facilities for students.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆为学生提供复印设施。
words.en: Photocopying facilities refer to the equipment and services provided for making photocopies.

words.ex: He put a sheet on the bed.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张床单铺在床上。
words.en: A thin, flat, rectangular piece of material, such as wood, metal, or paper.

words.tr: phrase. 黑白复印件；黑白复制品
words.ex: He made black-and-white copies of the document.
words.ex_cn: 他复印了这份文件的黑白副本。
words.en: Photocopies or prints made in black ink only, without color.

words.ex: The teacher hung a wall-chart of the planets in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里挂了一张行星的挂图。
words.en: A wall-chart is a large diagram or picture that is hung on a wall, especially in a classroom, to help students learn about a particular subject.

words.tr: n. 长袍；礼服( robe的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The priests wear white robes during the ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 神职人员在仪式上穿着白色长袍。
words.en: Long, loose outer garments, especially those worn on formal or ceremonial occasions.

words.ex: She uses a hairdryer every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上都用吹风机。
words.en: A hairdryer is an electrical device used to blow warm or hot air over wet hair to speed up the evaporation of water and dry the hair.

words.ex: The museum offers free entry on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆在星期日免费入场。
words.en: The permission or right to enter a place or event without payment.

words.tr: phrase. 顶级会员资格；高级会员身份
words.ex: He signed up for premier membership to get free shipping.
words.ex_cn: 他注册了高级会员以获得免费送货。
words.en: A premier membership is a type of membership that offers additional benefits and privileges compared to standard memberships.

words.tr: phrase. 联合会员资格；共同会员身份
words.ex: They have a joint membership at the gym.
words.ex_cn: 他们有一张共同的健身房会员卡。
words.en: Joint membership refers to the status or condition of being a member of two or more organizations, clubs, or groups simultaneously, often with shared benefits or privileges.

words.tr: phrase. 个人会员资格；个人会籍
words.ex: He bought an individual membership to the gym.
words.ex_cn: 他购买了健身房的个人会员资格。
words.en: The status of being a member of a group, organization, or club as an individual.

words.tr: phrase. 健身经理；负责管理健身房运营、人员和会员服务的职位
words.ex: He works as a fitness manager at a gym.
words.ex_cn: 他在健身房担任健身教练。
words.en: A fitness manager is responsible for the overall management of a fitness facility or gym, including staff supervision, program development, and ensuring a high level of customer service.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.tr: phrase. 运动损伤；体育活动中造成的身体伤害
words.ex: Many sports injuries happen during soccer games.
words.ex_cn: 许多运动损伤发生在足球比赛中。
words.en: Physical harm or damage sustained during participation in sports or exercise activities.

words.tr: phrase. 青少年比赛；青少年竞赛
words.ex: He won the junior competition last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月赢得了青少年比赛。
words.en: A contest or event for younger or less experienced participants.

words.tr: phrase. 高级别比赛；资深组竞赛（通常指年龄较大或经验较丰富的参赛者参与的赛事）
words.ex: He won medals in senior competitions last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年在高级别比赛中赢得了奖牌。
words.en: Senior competitions refer to high-level contests or tournaments, typically involving participants who are more experienced or advanced in their field.

words.tr: phrase. 收取费用；收集款项
words.ex: The teacher will collect the fees from the students tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天将向学生们收取费用。
words.en: To gather money that is owed, typically for services or goods provided.

words.tr: phrase. 监督团队；管理团队工作
words.ex: He supervises the teams every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天监督这些团队。
words.en: Oversee and guide groups of people.

words.ex: The car drove slowly on a winding road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车缓缓行驶在一条蜿蜒的道路上。
words.en: A road that has a lot of bends and turns.

words.ex: The car stopped in the turning area.
words.ex_cn: 汽车停在了转弯区域。
words.en: A designated space or area where vehicles can turn around or change direction.

words.ex: The boy walked down the long corridor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩走过了长长的走廊。
words.en: A corridor is a long passage in a building, with doors and rooms on one or both sides.

words.ex: The books are on the shelf beside the aisle.
words.ex_cn: 书在过道旁边的架子上。
words.en: An aisle is a long narrow gap that people can walk along between rows of seats in a public building such as a church or between rows of shelves in a supermarket.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲；曲线；
v. （使）弯成弧形；
words.ex: The road has a sharp curve ahead.
words.ex_cn: 前面的路有一个急转弯。
words.en: A curve is a smooth, gradually bending line, for example part of the edge of a circle.

words.ex: The car stopped at the junction.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交叉路口停了下来。
words.en: A junction is a place where two or more things, especially roads or railways, come together.

words.tr: n. 交叉；相交；十字路口；交叉路口；
words.ex: The intersection of two roads is busy.
words.ex_cn: 两条路的交叉口很繁忙。
words.en: An intersection is a place where roads or other lines meet or cross.

words.ex: The car stopped at a crossroad.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交叉路口停了下来。
words.en: A crossroad is a place where two roads meet and cross each other, or a point at which an important decision must be made.

words.tr: phrase. 丁字形道路；T型路口
words.ex: The car stopped at the T-road and turned left.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在丁字路口停下，然后左转了。
words.en: A T-road is a type of road intersection where one road ends and intersects another road, forming a 'T' shape.

words.tr:
n. 大楼；大厦；块；街区；障碍物；
v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: The new block is next to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这栋新大楼就在公园旁边。
words.en: A block is a large solid piece of material with flat surfaces on each side. As a verb, to block means to prevent movement or progress.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.ex: He waited in the foyer before the show started.
words.ex_cn: 演出开始前，他在门厅里等候。
words.en: A foyer is an area at the front of a building, especially a hotel or theater, where people can wait or meet others.

words.tr: phrase. 双扇门；成对的门，通常指由两扇门组成的入口，可向内或向外开启
words.ex: He pushed open the double doors and walked inside.
words.ex_cn: 他推开双扇门走了进去。
words.en: A pair of doors that are designed to open together, often used for grand entrances or to allow for the passage of large items.

words.ex: The path leads to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这条路通向村庄。
words.en: A path is a way or track designed for walking or traveling along, especially through the countryside.

words.tr: phrase. 旁道；侧路；小径（通常指偏离主路的次要路径）
words.ex: He walked on the side path to avoid the busy road.
words.ex_cn: 他走在小路上，以避开繁忙的马路。
words.en: A side path is a small road or track that branches off from a main road or path, often used as a shortcut or to avoid traffic.

words.ex: The road is long and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 这条路又长又安静。
words.en: A road is a long piece of hard ground which is built between two places so that people can drive or ride easily from one place to the other.

words.tr: phrase. 主干道；主要公路；大街
words.ex: The car stopped on the main road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车停在主路上。
words.en: A main road is a major road that is used by a lot of traffic, especially one that connects towns or cities.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲处；
v. （使）弯曲；
words.ex: The car turned at the bend in the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在道路的拐弯处转弯了。
words.en: To bend something means to change its shape so that it is no longer straight but curved.

words.ex: The car slowed down at the sharp bend.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在急转弯处减速了。
words.en: A sharp bend is a sudden and significant change in direction, especially in a road, path, or river.

words.tr: n. 进入；入口；条目；参与；参赛作品；
words.ex: The entry to the building is locked after 10 PM.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物在晚上10点后进入通道会被锁上。
words.en: An entry is the act of going into a place or the right to go into it. It can also refer to a door, gate, or passage by which you enter a place. Additionally, an entry can be a piece of information recorded in a book, list, or computer, or the act of recording it.

words.ex: The entrance to the building is on the left.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的入口在左边。
words.en: An entrance is a way into a place, such as a door or gate. It can also refer to the act of entering a place or the right to enter.

words.ex: He entered the building through the side entrance.
words.ex_cn: 他从侧门进入大楼。
words.en: A side entrance is a door or gate at the side of a building, used as an alternative to the main entrance.

words.tr: v. 转；转动；转弯；“turn”的现在分词； n. 转弯处；拐弯处；岔路口；
words.ex: He is turning the key to open the door.
words.ex_cn: 他正在转动钥匙开门。
words.en: A turning is a place where a road branches off another road.

words.ex: The children are playing on the riverbank.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河岸上玩耍。
words.en: On the bank of a river.

words.tr: adj. 圆圈的；环形的；循环的；
words.ex: The table has a circular top.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子有一个圆形的桌面。
words.en: Something that is circular is shaped like a circle.

words.tr:
n. 圆；圈；
v. 圈出；环绕；
words.ex: The child drew a circle with a pen.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用笔画了一个圆。
words.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

words.ex: He drew a half circle on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个半圆。
words.en: A half circle is a shape that is half of a circle, formed by cutting a whole circle along its diameter.

words.ex: The table has a rectangular shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是矩形的。
words.en: Something that is rectangular has the shape of a rectangle.

words.ex: The box has a rectangle shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是长方形的。
words.en: A rectangle is a four-sided flat shape where every interior angle is a right angle (90°). Opposite sides are parallel and of equal length.

words.ex: The pizza was cut into a triangular shape.
words.ex_cn: 比萨被切成三角形。
words.en: Something that is triangular has three straight sides and three angles, or is shaped like a triangle.

words.ex: The triangle has three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三条边。
words.en: A triangle is a shape consisting of three straight lines and three angles.

words.tr:
n. 平方；广场；正方形；四方形；
adj. 正方形的；四方形的；平方的；成直角的；
v. 与...一致；
adv. 成直角地；
words.ex: The area of the room is 16 square.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的面积是16平方米。
words.en: A square is a shape with four sides of equal length and four angles of 90 degrees. It can also refer to an open area in a town, often used for public events, or to the result of multiplying a number by itself.

words.tr:
adv. 正确地；直接地；向右；
adj. 正确的；右边的；
n. 右边；权利；
v. 纠正；
words.ex: He answered the question right.
words.ex_cn: 他正确地回答了问题。
words.en: If something is right, it is correct and agrees with the facts.

words.tr: v. 离开；“leave”的过去式和过去分词； n. 左；左边； adj. 左边的； adv. 向左；在左边；
words.ex: He left the house early this morning.
words.ex_cn: 他今天早上早早离开了家。
words.en: If there is a certain amount of something left, or if you have a certain amount of it left, it remains when the rest has gone or been used.

words.tr:
prep. 在…后面；
adv. 在后面；
words.ex: The cat is behind the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫在沙发后面。
words.en: If something is behind a thing or person, it is on the far side of them as they face you, or is in a back part of them.

words.ex: He sat beside his friend on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在朋友旁边。
words.en: At the side of; next to.

words.tr:
prep. 在…下面；低于；少于；
adv. 在下面；
words.ex: The cat is below the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: If something is below something else, it is in a lower position.

words.ex: He sent the message via email.
words.ex_cn: 他通过电子邮件发送了这条消息。
words.en: If you go somewhere via a particular place, you go through that place on the way to your destination.

words.ex: My friend always backs up my ideas in meetings.
words.ex_cn: 我的朋友总是在会议上支持我的想法。
words.en: To support someone or something; to make a copy of computer data to protect against loss.

words.tr: phrase. 开始；率先；作为开端；首先发言
words.ex: He will lead off the meeting with a short speech.
words.ex_cn: 他将用一段简短的演讲开场。
words.en: To begin something, especially a discussion, game, or event.

words.tr: phrase. 从A引向B；把……从A带到B；使……由A通往B
words.ex: The road leads from the village to the river.
words.ex_cn: 这条路从村庄通向河边。
words.en: To guide or direct someone or something from one place or situation to another.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （从某处）分出，分支；（从某事物）脱离出来
words.ex: The road branches off from the main highway.
words.ex_cn: 这条路从主干道分岔出来。
words.en: To separate from something and go in a different direction.

words.w: on the other side from A
words.tr: phrase. 在…的另一边；从…的另一侧
words.uk: ɒn ðə ˈʌðə saɪd frɒm ə
words.us: ɑːn ði ˈʌðər saɪd frəm ə
words.ex: The cat is on the other side from the door.
words.ex_cn: 猫在门的另一边。
words.en: On the opposite side of something.

words.w: on the same side as A
words.tr: phrase. 与……在同一侧；站在……一边；与……立场一致
words.ex: He stood on the same side as a friend during the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中和朋友站在同一边。
words.en: prep. Located on the identical side of something as another object or person.

words.ex: The moon's far side never faces Earth.
words.ex_cn: 月球的背面从不朝向地球。
words.en: The far side refers to the side of an object, especially a celestial body like the moon, that is always facing away from the observer on Earth.

words.ex: The answer is beyond my understanding.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案超出了我的理解。
words.en: If something is beyond a place or barrier, it is on the other side of it.

words.tr:
prep. 穿过；横过；在…对面；
adv. 横过；穿过；越过；
words.ex: He walked across the street.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过街道。
words.en: From one side to the other of something with clear limits, such as an area of land, a road, or a river.

words.tr:
v. 横过；穿过；交叉；
n. 十字架；十字形记号；
adj. 恼怒的；
words.ex: Please cross the street carefully.
words.ex_cn: 请小心横过街道。
words.en: To go from one side of something to the other; to place or lie across something else; to oppose.

words.tr:
prep. 通过；穿过；
adv. 从头到尾地；彻底；
adj. 直通的；
words.ex: He walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过了门。
words.en: Moving in one side and out of the other side of (an opening, channel, or location).

words.tr:
n. 过去；昔日；
adj. 过去的；昔日的；
prep. 超过；晚于；
adv. 经过；
words.ex: He never talks about the past.
words.ex_cn: 他从不谈论过去。
words.en: The past is the time before the present, and the things that have happened.

words.tr: adj. 伴随的；共轭的（数学中用于矩阵或算子）
words.ex: The matrix has an adjoint that helps solve equations.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩阵有一个伴随矩阵，可以帮助解方程。
words.en: an operator that is related to another by a specific integral relationship, often in functional analysis

words.ex: He walks go toward the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走向公园。
words.en: To move in the direction of something.

words.tr: phrase. 向上朝向；朝着…的上方移动
words.ex: The bird flew up towards the sky.
words.ex_cn: 鸟飞向天空。
words.en: In the direction of something that is higher or further along a path.

words.ex: The cat is sitting in front of the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子前面。
words.en: If someone or something is in front of a particular thing, they are facing it, ahead of it, or close to the front part of it.

words.tr: phrase. 对面的；对立的；相反的
words.ex: The park is opposite to the school.
words.ex_cn: 公园在学校的对面。
words.en: in a position on the other side of a specific area from something; facing.

words.ex: The keys are by the entrance.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙在入口处。
words.en: Near the entrance or doorway.

words.ex: The chair is facing you.
words.ex_cn: 椅子正对着你。
words.en: Positioned directly in front of someone, with the front part facing them.

words.tr: 短语：在某个以字母 'a' 开头的事物前向右转（常用于导航指令）
words.ex: Turn right before a store.
words.ex_cn: 在商店前右转。
words.en: To change direction to the right side before reaching a specific point or location.

words.tr: phrase. 一直往前走；径直向下走
words.ex: Walk straight down the road to find the post office.
words.ex_cn: 沿着这条路直走，就能找到邮局。
words.en: Proceed in a direct, forward direction without turning, following a path or route.

words.ex: Go straight ahead to find the park.
words.ex_cn: 一直往前走，就能找到公园。
words.en: To continue moving forward in a straight line without turning.

words.tr: phrase. 沿着……走，直到……（表示动作持续到某个时间点或地点）
words.ex: Walk along the street until you see the red house.
words.ex_cn: 沿着这条街走，直到你看到那栋红房子。
words.en: To continue walking in a specified direction until a particular point or time is reached.

words.ex: Go along the street until you see the red house.
words.ex_cn: 沿着这条街走，直到你看到那栋红色的房子。
words.en: To continue moving or proceeding until a certain point or condition is reached.

words.ex: He will call you at the end of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他会在会议结束时给你打电话。
words.en: Indicates the final part of a period of time, an event, a process, or a physical object.

words.ex: The cat is sitting between the two chairs.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在两把椅子之间。
words.en: If something is between two things or is in between them, it has one of the things on one side of it and the other thing on the other side.

words.ex: The café is on the corner of Main Street and Oak Avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这家咖啡馆在主街和橡树大道的拐角处。
words.en: A corner is a point or an area where two or more edges, sides, or surfaces of something meet. It can also refer to a difficult situation or to the act of gaining control of a market.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 在弯道处；处于弯曲状态
words.ex: The car stopped on the bend.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在弯道处停了下来。
words.en: In a curve or turn, or in a difficult situation.

words.ex: The fence marks the boundary between the two gardens.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏标志着两个花园的分界线。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.tr: phrase. 面向；朝向；俯瞰（指窗户、阳台等所朝向的景色）
words.ex: The window looks out on a small garden.
words.ex_cn: 这扇窗户俯瞰着一个小花园。
words.en: To have a view of something from a particular place.

words.tr: phrase. 面向；俯瞰；朝向（指从某处向外能看到某景色）
words.ex: The window looks out onto the garden.
words.ex_cn: 这扇窗朝向花园。
words.en: To have a view of something from a particular position or direction.

words.ex: The cat is right next to the door.
words.ex_cn: 猫就在门旁边。
words.en: Immediately adjacent to or very close to something.

words.tr: phrase. 直到最后；一直到底
words.ex: He kept running right to the end.
words.ex_cn: 他一直跑到最后。
words.en: Continuing until the very end without stopping or giving up.

words.tr:
v. 转换；
n. 开关；
words.ex: He switched off the light before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前把灯关掉了。
words.en: A switch is a small control for an electrical device which you use to turn the device on or off.

words.ex: He turned the knob to adjust the volume.
words.ex_cn: 他转动旋钮来调节音量。
words.en: A knob is a round handle, or a round switch on a piece of equipment.

words.ex: He drew a little square on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个小方块。
words.en: A small, often square-shaped area or object.

words.ex: The coat has a round button.
words.ex_cn: 这件外套有一个圆形纽扣。
words.en: A round button is a circular control element that can be pressed to perform a specific function.
